localeEntries./event/halloween/lead: The burnt-out stormstones glow again, this time with a cold, blue wisp light. Break them, collect Wisp Lanterns and trade them for festival rewards. The fox is coming too, but she only has time at weekends.
localeEntries./event/halloween/items/0/text: Free daily fights at your hero's level. Every win brings Wisp Lanterns.
localeEntries./event/halloween/items/1/text: Weekend boss: she only shows up on Saturdays and Sundays. On weekdays she combs her tails.
localeEntries./event/halloween/items/2/text: Collected lanterns earn you the Wisp Steed mount, the Wisp Flame frame and the Warden of the Dead Stones title.
localeEntries./event/halloween/items/3/text: Trade your lanterns for scrolls, an egg and the Lantern Lighter title.
localeEntries./event/halloween/alt: A glowing dead stone in a lantern-lit night market, with the Nine-Tailed fox against the moon
localeEntries./faq/0/a: Stonestorm is a browser MMORPG set in an East Asian fantasy world: your hero hunts, levels up and gathers loot even while you're busy with something else. Three kingdoms, four classes and six lands await you, with nothing to install, on phone and desktop.
localeEntries./faq/1/q: Do I have to pay to play?
localeEntries./faq/1/a: No. Stonestorm is free to play and runs in your browser with nothing to install, on phone and desktop.
localeEntries./faq/2/a: Honestly: a bit. Paying speeds things up, and in the endgame it gives some extra strength too. The weekly boss, fishing and events are the same for everyone, though, and since there's no trading between players, nobody can buy power from someone else. The blacksmith grumbles at everyone equally anyway.
localeEntries./faq/3/a: Pick a kingdom and a class, and your hero heads out hunting, even while you're at work or asleep. You collect the loot, swap gear, upgrade at the forge, smash stormstones, and when you feel strong enough, you take on the region's boss. A few minutes a day is enough, but we won't complain if you lose track of time.
localeEntries./faq/4/q: Can I trade with other players?
localeEntries./faq/4/a: No. You earn everything yourself: there is no player-to-player market where money or bots can buy you an edge.
localeEntries./faq/5/a: Anything with a modern browser: phone, tablet or computer, no installation needed. On Android, get the app from Google Play. On iPhone and iPad, for now, add it to your home screen (Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen) and it opens from its own icon in full screen. Your hero stays the same wherever you log in from.
localeEntries./faq/6/a: Yes. The Android version is out on Google Play, and the App Store and Steam versions are in progress. It's the same game as in the browser, just easier to start. Your account and your hero come with you, so you pick up right where you left off.
localeEntries./faq/7/a: Stonestorm's art world was built by our artists. Some images were refined with AI tools, and every piece was reviewed and approved by our artists.
localeEntries./faq/8/q: Can I have more than one hero?
localeEntries./faq/8/a: Yes. You can have up to 4 heroes on one account, each with its own Storm Coins and items. A new hero needs a confirmed email address, and there is a 24-hour wait between new heroes.
localeEntries./faq/9/a: In 30 languages: Hungarian, English, Turkish, German, Polish, Romanian, Czech, Italian, Spanish, Greek, Portuguese, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Dutch, Danish, Arabic, Slovak, Swedish, Norwegian, Ukrainian, Russian, Bulgarian, Macedonian, Lithuanian, Estonian, Finnish, Albanian, Croatian, Serbian and Slovenian. You can switch between them in the game any time.
localeEntries./faq/10/a: We announce everything new here on this page and on our Discord, and in the game the notice board spreads the word. Our community channels are already open: you will find the links at the bottom of this page.

localeEntries./lore/prologue: One night was enough: the emperor's astrologer tore the scales from the Storm Dragon, the Dragon Throne fell, and the emperor's three children each took a kingdom. The scales still fall back as stormstones, and wherever one lands, even the cows start looking suspicious.
localeEntries./lore/chapters/0/text: Once there was a single empire, and on the Dragon Throne sat an old emperor who laughed more often than he gave orders. His three children grew up together in the palace gardens. Bonghwa, the eldest, learned to hold a sword before a spoon. Horang, the middle one, read books by day and haggled at the market by night, and nobody could beat Horang at either. Miru, the youngest, was already marching toy soldiers about by command, and not one of them dared to break rank. They loved each other, and as long as they stood together the realm prospered, and a storm was only rain.
localeEntries./lore/chapters/1/text: Then came a storm unlike any before it. Instead of thunder there was a deep roar, and glowing stones fell from the sky along with the rain. Where they landed, dogs turned on their masters, wolves broke into the villages, and sensible people lost their minds. The old emperor died that same night, and by morning the capital was in flames. Of the palace gardens where the three siblings grew up, only ash remained.
localeEntries./lore/chapters/2/text: In their grief the siblings blamed each other, because someone had to be blamed and the stones would not answer. Bonghwa wanted to smash every stone, Horang wanted to study them, and Miru wanted to wall them all away. None of them would give way, so each left with their followers and founded a kingdom under their own name: red Bonghwa, yellow Horang and blue Miru. Since then the borders have rarely been quiet, and the family dinners have been cancelled too. They agree on exactly one thing: all three of them hate the stones.
localeEntries./lore/chapters/3/text: The old faith says the Storm Dragon sends the storms to test the realm. This trial is not passed with prayer but with sword, dagger, flame and lightning: the Stormbreakers hunt down the stones and break them before they can do worse. Whether one empire or three kingdoms will be standing when the trial ends, the faith does not say. You arrive as a recruit in a border village of your kingdom, where the stones are still falling. The captain is already waiting for you, and so is the village blacksmith, though mostly for your money.
localeEntries./lore/empires/shinju/founding: Bonghwa marched off with the bravest fighters and raised the red banner wherever the stones fell thickest. The kingdom has been a land of proud warriors ever since, where every quarrel ends in a duel and honour is worth more than gold.
localeEntries./lore/empires/chunji/founding: Horang set out with the scholars and merchants and founded a city where the old trade roads meet, a place where every stone is measured and recorded before it is broken. The yellow kingdom has been home to merchants and scholars ever since, where people debate at the market and haggle in the library.
localeEntries./lore/empires/jinha/founding: Miru left with the most disciplined troops and raised a wall against the stones, then a second one in case the first gave way. The blue kingdom has been a land of order and discipline ever since, where rules are carved in stone and everyone actually follows them.
localeEntries./lore/tagline: There was one empire. Now there are three kingdoms.
localeEntries./npc/blacksmith/greeting: Well, what have you brought me? Rusty is fine. Expensive is even better.
localeEntries./npc/shopkeeper/greeting: Hi there! Come on in, everything's on sale today. Well, not everything, but you're so sweet.
localeEntries./npc/board/greeting: Hear ye, hear ye! Today's news is already up on the board!
localeEntries./npc/captain/greeting: Halt. Stand up straight. There, you almost look like a soldier.
localeEntries./npc/biologist/greeting: Well, well, a live adventurer! I mean, welcome. No sudden movements, I'm taking notes.
localeEntries./npc/stable/greeting: Hi! Sorry about the straw, the horse says it's in fashion.
localeEntries./npc/alchemist/greeting: Don't touch anything! Especially what's smoking. And what isn't.
localeEntries./npc/old_lady/greeting: Come here, dear! Sit down a minute, and then I'll send you somewhere.
localeEntries./npc/fisherman/greeting: Keep it down. The fish can hear. Supposedly.
localeEntries./npc/storekeeper/greeting: Good day! Everything's safe with me. Especially from you.
localeEntries./npc/weapon_dealer/greeting: Look at all this sharp merchandise! Don't touch the edges, that costs extra.
localeEntries./npc/armor_dealer/greeting: What are you staring at? That's not a dent, that's experience.
localeEntries./npc/auctioneer/greeting: Welcome to the Triple Seal! Fixed prices when we sell, fixed prices when we buy.
localeEntries./paths/warrior_a/tagline: One sword, one direction: round and round.
localeEntries./paths/warrior_a/desc: Knights used to charge at windmills. These days the windmill charges at everyone, with a greatsword where the sails should be. Never dizzy, never tired, and always puzzled why everyone flees once the warm-up starts.
localeEntries./paths/warrior_b/tagline: Shield first, pain can wait its turn.
localeEntries./paths/warrior_b/desc: Running into a Stonewall is like headbutting a mountain: the mountain doesn't even notice. Stonewalls charge in shield first and only half notice the next two hits. Healers adore them, because they almost never need healing.
localeEntries./paths/ninja_a/tagline: Small, fast, and always stings twice.
localeEntries./paths/ninja_a/desc: Wasps aren't big, but a single one can empty a whole camp. They work with twin daggers and treat armour as more of a suggestion. If you hear the buzzing, it's too late, and if you don't, it's even later.
localeEntries./paths/ninja_b/tagline: Shoots from afar. Up close, nobody's left.
localeEntries./paths/ninja_b/desc: Rainmakers never come close, and why would they? One pull of the bowstring sends up a whole cloud of arrows, and the forecast is in: overcast, with a hundred percent chance of arrows. They dodge well too, because what never reaches you can't hurt.
localeEntries./paths/mage_a/tagline: Every strike a bite, every bite a life.
localeEntries./paths/mage_a/desc: The demon in the blade is always hungry, and a Glutton never says no to it. Every strike nips a mouthful off the enemy's life and patches the Glutton up with it. Every innkeeper in the region has banned Gluttons, and all they ever asked for was soup.
localeEntries./paths/mage_b/tagline: The one monsters fear in the dark.
localeEntries./paths/mage_b/desc: Village mothers threaten their children with the Bogeyman, and the children pass the threat on to the monsters. Bogeyman magic doesn't knock on armour, it goes straight through to the soul, where all that's left is a cold sweat. Best avoided after dark, and approached with care in daylight.
localeEntries./paths/shaman_a/tagline: One flick of the fan, then thunder.
localeEntries./paths/shaman_a/desc: A Thunderfan settles any argument with one flick of the wrist, usually by settling the other party. Then comes a polite bow, because manners matter, especially over a pile of ash. Nobody argues with a Thunderfan on a rainy day, and on sunny days only those who forgot to look up.
localeEntries./paths/shaman_b/tagline: Heals, protects, and only sometimes calls lightning.
localeEntries./paths/shaman_b/desc: A Cloud Shepherd herds clouds the way others herd sheep, and any cloud that strays comes back with lightning. Every strike is a heavenly poultice: it stings the enemy and soothes the shepherd. They get more out of potions than anyone, too, because they know which end to drink from.

localeEntries./seo/description: Browser MMORPG in an East Asian fantasy world: three kingdoms, four classes, six lands. Your hero fights on while you're away. In your browser, on any device.
localeEntries./soon/pageTitle: Stonestorm: fantasy browser MMORPG, coming soon
localeEntries./soon/hero/kicker: A free browser MMORPG in an East Asian fantasy world
localeEntries./soon/hero/trailer/1: Then stones fell from the sky, and the peace shattered.
localeEntries./soon/hero/trailer/2: The stones still call. Someone has to answer.
localeEntries./soon/hero/trailer/3: Soon your hero stands in the eye of the storm.
localeEntries./soon/hero/title: The MMO you grew up with.
localeEntries./soon/hero/lead: A browser MMORPG in an East Asian fantasy world: your hero hunts and grows stronger even while you're busy with something else. The gates are still closed, but you can join the waitlist now, and we'll tell you first when they open.
localeEntries./soon/hero/fine: Free to play at launch, with in-game purchases
localeEntries./soon/hero/sub: Falling stormstones, three kingdoms and sweaty palms at the blacksmith. Only now your hero keeps hunting while you're busy.
localeEntries./soon/waitlist/text: Stonestorm is still in the making: the village, the blacksmith and the stone guardians are getting their final touches. Sign up and you will be the first to know when the gates open.
localeEntries./soon/waitlist/formText: You'll get an email now to confirm your signup, with your personal founder code already in it: confirming activates the code (if you forget, we remind you at most twice). After that we only write about the launch. You can unsubscribe at any time.
localeEntries./soon/waitlist/ok: We've sent you an email. Confirm your signup with the link inside, and you're on the waitlist. Can't find it? Check your spam folder too.
localeEntries./soon/waitlist/consent: For your signup we store your email address, the time of signup and your IP address until you unsubscribe.
localeEntries./soon/follow/text: Our community channels open before launch. That is where the news, previews and behind-the-scenes stories will be.
localeEntries./soon/halloween/title: The night of the stones returns soon.
localeEntries./soon/halloween/founder: Waitlist members get a personal founder code in the confirmation email, activated when they confirm: the Founder title, the Founder's Seal frame and the Wisp Steed for a week.
localeEntries./soon/halloween/ctaLead: Be there on the Night of the Dead Stones!
localeEntries./soon/seo/description: Free browser MMORPG in an East Asian fantasy world, opening October 31. Three kingdoms, four classes, six regions. Join the waitlist: founder gift.
localeEntries./soon/modes/title: What will you do in there?
localeEntries./soon/modes/lead: Here's what waits behind the gates once they open. Short version, the blacksmith is getting impatient.
localeEntries./soon/modes/hunt/text: Your hero hunts on their own, even while you sleep. You collect the loot and decide who's next.
localeEntries./soon/modes/tower/text: A hundred and twenty floors, no elevator. Every thirtieth floor has a boss who can't stand people taking the stairs.
localeEntries./soon/modes/forge/text: Push your weapon to +9 if you dare. If it works, everyone's jealous. If not, Gangdo offers his condolences and adds the ashes to the pile.
localeEntries./soon/modes/fishing/text: Nakshi says the fish can hear you. Sit quietly by the lake and find out who lasts longer.
localeEntries./soon/modes/guilds/text: A shared fortress, a daily guild boss, a leaderboard. You could go it alone, but why would you?
localeEntries./soon/modes/event/text: Two weeks of dead stones, a nine-tailed fox and holiday rewards.
localeEntries./soon/modes/mmo/lead: An MMORPG is better with company. From launch, all of this is part of the game:
localeEntries./soon/modes/mmo/profiles/text: Click anyone's name to see their gear, their title and their guild.
localeEntries./soon/modes/mmo/friends/text: A friends list, online status and ready-made greetings. Nothing to moderate.
localeEntries./soon/modes/mmo/stoneRain/text: Several times a day, stones rain down on the town. Smash them fast and the whole world gets a blessing.
localeEntries./soon/modes/mmo/guildChat/text: Live chat inside your guild. You can complain about the blacksmith here too.
localeEntries./soon/event/lead: On launch night, the burnt-out stones flare up again in cold blue wisp light. For two weeks you can smash them and collect Wisp Lanterns along the way: lanterns earn rewards, the fox earns glory.
localeEntries./soon/event/items/0/text: Three free fights a day at your hero's level. Every win is worth Wisp Lanterns.
localeEntries./soon/event/items/1/text: A weekend boss who only shows up on Saturdays and Sundays. Two wins and the Foxbane title is yours.
localeEntries./soon/event/dawn: Create a hero within 72 hours of launch and you get the First Dawn title. Just for being there.
localeEntries./soon/event/gift: Everyone on the waitlist gets a personal founder code in the confirmation email, activated when they confirm: the Founder title, the Founder's Seal frame, the Wisp Steed for a week, 10,000 Nyang, 3 Ashward Scrolls and 10 Healing Potions. Redeem it from 31 October to 15 November in an account registered with the email address we sent it to.
localeEntries./soon/event/story/0: Every year on this night, the burnt-out stones flare up again. Blue, cold, and a little offended.
localeEntries./soon/event/story/1: The dokkebi play pranks at the market, the wisps hang around the well, and the ghost in white waits in line like everyone else.
localeEntries./soon/event/story/2: Up in the hills, a nine-tailed fox beckons with a lantern. Don't go. Fine, go, but only at the weekend, and bring a sword.
localeEntries./soon/event/story/3: We light lanterns for the emperor. Gangdo says the lanterns are for sale too, but tonight nobody is listening to him.
localeEntries./soon/event/timeline/open: Launch: the event and Storm Road Season 1 begin
localeEntries./soon/event/timeline/fox: Nine-Tailed weekend: Hwaryeon roams the hills
localeEntries./soon/event/timeline/end: Last day of the event. The Lantern Shop stays open two more days.
localeEntries./soon/event/showcase/lead: Titles, frames and a mount that glows at night. Most of it just takes playing, the Storm Road premium track is paid.
localeEntries./soon/event/src/steed: for collected lanterns, for two weeks
localeEntries./soon/event/src/dawn: Hero created in the first 72 hours
localeEntries./soon/event/pass/text: Starts at launch and runs until November 30. The free track is for everyone, the premium track adds the holiday frame and title.
localeEntries./soon/event/more: Event details: schedule and every reward
localeEntries./soon/faq/0/a: Not yet. Opening: {{date}}, {{time}} ({{zone}}). Until then, join the waitlist: your personal founder code is already in the confirmation email, confirming activates it, and you can redeem it from launch.
localeEntries./soon/faq/1/q: What do I get for signing up?
localeEntries./soon/faq/1/a: Your personal founder code, already in the confirmation email and activated when you confirm: the Founder title, the Founder's Seal frame, the Wisp Steed for a week, 10,000 Nyang, 3 Ashward Scrolls and 10 Healing Potions. From launch, you redeem it in an account registered with that same email address. No spam, and you can unsubscribe any time.
localeEntries./soon/features/hunt/title: It hunts even when you don't
localeEntries./soon/features/forge/title: Three hammer blows and a prayer
localeEntries./soon/features/home/text: You start with a crooked shack and a goat on the roof. Furnish it, hang trophies on the wall, and every bit of comfort adds a little XP.
localeEntries./soon/features/look/text: A backdrop behind your hero, a frame around your portrait, a glow on your name: everyone sees them on your profile, in the arena and in chat. No stats, just style.
localeEntries./soon/features/rain/title: When the stones fall, everyone runs
localeEntries./tower/intro: The old empire built the Stormcatcher to catch the storm before it hit the ground. It never caught the storm, but a demon moved in, and he has been subletting the floors to the worst crowd in the land ever since.
localeEntries./tower/bosses/tower_boss_1/line: Password? Wrong. I don't know the right one either, but it isn't that.
localeEntries./tower/bosses/tower_boss_2/line: Look into my eyes, just for a moment. There, you've already forgotten why you came.
localeEntries./tower/bosses/tower_boss_3/line: I checked the list. You're on it, just a little earlier than you expected.
localeEntries./tower/bosses/tower_boss_4/line: Who let you in? Oh, the tenants. Rent goes up tomorrow.
localeEntries./tower/floors/0: On the lower floors the toughest enemy is the stairs, and the monsters come second.
localeEntries./tower/floors/1: Fox hair on the banister, perfume in the corridor: someone is expecting you.
localeEntries./tower/floors/2: A sign on the wall says: please take a number. Yours has already been called.
localeEntries./tower/floors/3: Sulphur, heat and overdue rent, and up here even the monsters walk on tiptoe.

localeEntries./twitchDrops/steps/2: Claim the drop on Twitch: the chest waits for you in the game for 7 days.

localeEntries./welcome/demo/ready: Done. The neighbour is already jealous.
localeEntries./welcome/demo/gift: That was just the demo. In the game your own hero does the forging, and whatever you hammer out stays yours.

localeEntries./welcome/founder/text: Waitlist members got their personal founder code by email. It can be redeemed in an account registered with the email address we sent it to, not as a guest. Deadline: {{date}}. Here's what it gives you:
localeEntries./welcome/founder/steps/0: Register with the email address we sent the code to (or log in to that account), and confirm the address.
localeEntries./welcome/founder/steps/2: The game offers to redeem it. You can also enter the code by hand on the Account page.
localeEntries./welcome/playSection/lead: Free, runs in your browser with nothing to install, on phone and desktop. Start right away as a guest and save your hero to a free account whenever you like.
localeEntries./welcome/faq/0/a: Yes, Stonestorm is open. Click “Play free now” and you can start right away as a guest. Later you can save your hero to a free account so it's with you on every device.
localeEntries./welcome/faq/1/q: I have a founder code. How do I redeem it?
localeEntries./welcome/faq/1/a: Register (or log in) with the email address we sent the code to, confirm the address, create your hero, and the game offers to redeem it. You can also enter it by hand on the Account page. It can't be redeemed with a different email address or as a guest. Deadline: {{date}}.

localeEntries./default/goal: Split the stormstone in two: hit the glowing weak points before they fade, and leave the dark, hardened spots alone.
localeEntries./default/help: Tap a glowing point before it fades: each hit cracks the stone further along its line. A dark spot heals the crack back a step, and a missed tap costs time. When all three lines are cracked through, the stone splits and the loot is yours.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/intro: This is a stormstone, dear. Glowing weak points light up along its fault lines.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/watch: Watch, one is about to glow!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/tap: Your turn: tap the glowing point before it fades! The crack grows.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/faded: It faded. No harm done, here comes the next one: tap it while it glows!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/more: Nice! Hit two more. Don't touch the dark, hardened points!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/darkWatch: Look out: sometimes a dark point shows up.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/dark: That's the one! Let it fade, don't tap it.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/darkHit: That was a dark point: it healed the crack back by one step. Let dark points fade!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/split: Now split it all the way: hit the glowing points until the stone breaks in two!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/end: Split in two! In the real game there are more cracks, and the points fade sooner.
localeEntries./default/next/silver: For silver: crack the stone further (now {{pct}}%, needed {{need}}%).
localeEntries./default/next/goldSplit: For gold: a flawless split (no dark spot, no faded spot, no missed tap), or {{secs}} s faster.
localeEntries./default/next/goldNoSplit: For gold: split the stone, flawlessly or faster.

localeEntries./default/goal: Land the fish: keep the glowing bar on it until the catch meter is full.
localeEntries./default/help: Hold down (or hold Space): the bar rises; let go: it sinks. The meter drops rewards on the way. When the fish trembles and a "!" appears, it is about to dart.
localeEntries./default/helpTouch: Keep your finger down: the bar rises; let go: it sinks. The meter drops rewards on the way. When the fish trembles and a "!" appears, it is about to dart.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/intro: This glowing bar is your hook. Hold down (or hold Space): it rises. Let go: it sinks.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/introTouch: This glowing bar is your hook. Keep your finger down: it rises. Let go: it sinks.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/stay: Keep the bar on the fish! If it went above, let go a little.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/meter: Like that! While you are on the fish, the catch meter on the right fills from the bottom up. Slip off the fish and it drains red.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/land: Keep it there until the meter is full: the fish at the top is the one you land!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/escaped: It got away! No harm done, let's try again: stay on the fish.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/end: Caught it! In the real game the fish sometimes darts away suddenly, but it trembles first and a "!" warns you: watch for it!

localeEntries./default/goal: Open the lock: pop every pin before time runs out.
localeEntries./default/help: Tap (or press Space) while the needle is inside the glowing band. With each pin the needle gets faster and the band narrower. A missed tap costs 1.5 seconds.
localeEntries./default/helpTouch: Tap while the needle is inside the glowing band. With each pin the needle gets faster and the band narrower. A missed tap costs 1.5 seconds.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/intro: This is the lock's dial, dear. The needle goes round; the glowing band is where the pin catches.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/first: Tap (or press Space) when the needle is in the glowing band!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/firstTouch: Tap when the needle is in the glowing band!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/second: A pin clicked! Now the needle turns back the other way, and the band is narrower.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/third: One more! In the real game it will be faster, but you already feel the rhythm.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/miss: Just off. Wait until the needle reaches the light, then tap!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/end: It's open! In the real game there are five pins, and a missed tap costs time.

localeEntries./tutorial/intro: This is the lock's dial, dear. The needle goes round; the glowing band is where the pin catches.
localeEntries./tutorial/first: Tap (or press Space) when the needle is in the glowing band!
localeEntries./tutorial/firstTouch: Tap when the needle is in the glowing band!
localeEntries./tutorial/second: A pin clicked! Now the needle turns back the other way, and the band is narrower.
localeEntries./tutorial/third: One more! In the real game it will be faster, but you already feel the rhythm.
localeEntries./tutorial/miss: Just off. Wait until the needle reaches the light, then tap!
localeEntries./tutorial/end: It's open! In the real game there are five pins, and a missed tap costs time.

localeEntries./default/help: Steer the catcher with WASD, the arrow keys, the mouse or the joystick. Tanakas are faster than you: corner them!
localeEntries./default/helpTouch: Drag your finger anywhere on the field and the catcher follows the motion, or use the joystick bottom left. Tanakas are faster than you: corner them!
localeEntries./default/tip/boost: After a catch you are faster for a moment: grab the next one too!
localeEntries./default/tip/net: The net widens your catching circle for a few seconds.
localeEntries./default/tip/golden: The golden Tanaka is rare and fast, but it drops big.
localeEntries./default/practice: Practice round: just try the controls, there is no reward.

localeEntries./default/goal: Follow the footprints to the treasure: tap them in the order they lit up, then dig up the chest.
localeEntries./default/help: Watch the order in which the footprints light up, then tap them in the same order, as fast as you can. A wrong print is a mistake, and a second mistake ends the round. At the end, tap the X quickly (or press Space) to dig up the chest.
localeEntries./default/helpTouch: Watch the order in which the footprints light up, then tap them in the same order, as fast as you can. A wrong print is a mistake, and a second mistake ends the round. At the end, tap the X quickly to dig up the chest.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/intro: This is the crumpled map, dear. The footprints hide along the trails and lead to the treasure.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/watch: Watch: the footprints light up one after another. Remember the order!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/first: Your turn: tap them in the same order. The first one lit up here.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/rest: Good! Now the rest, in the same order.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/wrong: That wasn't the next one. Watch the order again!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/toDig: You found the trail! Now let's dig.
localeEntries./default/tutorial/dig: Tap the X quickly (or press Space) to dig up the chest!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/digTouch: Tap the X quickly to dig up the chest!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/digAgain: Once more, a little faster: tap the X!
localeEntries./default/tutorial/end: Dug up! In the real game there are three rounds with longer and longer trails, and the clock runs while you tap.

localeEntries./default/goal: Stones are crashing onto the map: smash them all before they sink into the ground!

localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/boss/desc: One more try against the map boss. It does not raise your odds, it just lets you go again.
localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/respec/desc: You get back every stat point you spent and can spend them again. The first time is free.
localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/reroll/desc: Three new offers instead of the current ones. The first reroll of the day is free.
localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/shopReroll/desc: Six new items instead of the shop's daily offer, each with a little extra.

localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/luck_ore/desc: +{{percent}} chance for a single upgrade. The chance can be at most {{max}}.

localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/inventory_8/desc: +8 slots in your inventory, for good. At most {{max}} expansions.
localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/mount/desc: {{name}} for {{days}} days: every foray is {{percent}} shorter.

localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/towerSkip/desc: The rest after an attempt in the Stormcatcher ends at once.
localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/researchSkip/desc: The monster scholar takes your next sample right away, without the wait between deliveries.
localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/hatchSkip/desc: The companion hatches from its egg at once.
localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/guildSkip/desc: The guild building under construction is finished at once.

localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/researchElixir/de: The monster scholar's next delivery has a better chance to succeed.

localeEntries./activeplay/shop/items/rename/desc: Give your hero a new name if the old one no longer fits.

localeEntries./alchemist/elixirs/stoneskin_brew/flavor: Claws, arrows and even your guild leader's remarks bounce right off you.
localeEntries./alchemist/extendNote: Another dose: the effect lasts {{hours}} hours longer.

localeEntries./alchemist/nyangUsed: No nyang buys left this week. Again from Monday.

localeEntries./alchemist/lines/bought/3: If your ears smoke, that is the effect. If your shoes smoke too, that is the side effect.
localeEntries./alchemist/lines/bought/4: Shake before drinking. Or don't. I never do.
localeEntries./alchemist/lines/extended: Another dose? As you wish, the effect lasts longer and there are no side effects. Supposedly.

localeEntries./depth/soul/sources/diamond: Frost Essence and Raw Moon Opal: M5 runs and background hunting.
localeEntries./depth/soul/sources/sapphire: Abyssal Pearl and Raw Azurite: Nakshi's fishing trades.
localeEntries./depth/soul/sources/jade: Spider Silk and Raw Emerald: heroic Spider Nest.
localeEntries./depth/soul/sources/onyx: Shadow Veil and Raw Nightstone: arena victories.
localeEntries./depth/soul/sources/garnet: Storm Blood and Raw Sunstone: weekly boss, heroic Dragon Nest.
localeEntries./depth/soul/sourceHouse: The Triple Seal also sells it for nyang, with a daily limit.
localeEntries./depth/soul/locked/text: The Stormheart opens together with the heroic dungeons. Required level: {{level}}.
localeEntries./depth/soul/locked/more: Six sockets, six stones: each one raises one main value, step by step, with the chance shown up front. When it opens you get a Raw Bloodstone for your first stone.
localeEntries./depth/soul/panel/gradeUp: Grade change: on success the stone becomes {{grade}}.
localeEntries./depth/soul/panel/wardHint: On failure the stone does not drop, and the seal is used only then. You have: {{qty}}
localeEntries./depth/soul/panel/wardNotNeeded: On this step the stone never drops, no seal needed.
localeEntries./depth/soul/panel/failDrop: If it fails, the materials are used up and the stone drops one step. With a Soulward Seal it does not drop.
localeEntries./depth/soul/panel/failStay: If it fails, the materials are used up, but on this step the stone does not drop.
localeEntries./depth/soul/panel/failStar: If it fails, the materials are used up. On Celestial stars the stone never drops.
localeEntries./depth/soul/panel/eyeNote: The Dragon Eye is used only on success.
localeEntries./depth/soul/panel/refineLabel: Refine: {{stone}}, chance {{chance}}, cost {{nyang}} nyang and the listed materials
localeEntries./depth/soul/panel/short: You don't have enough materials for this attempt.
localeEntries./depth/soul/chanceTip/cap: The chance is at most {{cap}}; more helpers don't raise it (and are not used).
localeEntries./depth/soul/chanceTip/note: The server rolls with exactly this chance. On a grade-change step the base is 10 points lower.
localeEntries./depth/soul/tip/where: Attack, Health and Defence grow on top of the other bonuses' caps. Critical chance and Evasion stay under their own caps, and the Sunstone counts toward the cap on damage against bosses. In the arena it works at half, in the Pure Arena not at all.
localeEntries./depth/soul/socket/text: The raw stone goes into the socket and becomes a Raw grade stone. Then you can refine it. The stone stays there, it cannot be swapped.
localeEntries./depth/soul/result/socketed: {{stone}} is in its socket. Now you can refine it.
localeEntries./depth/soul/result/socketedShort: {{stone}} is in its socket. To refine it you still need materials: whatever you are short of is red in the list.
localeEntries./depth/soul/result/warded: It failed, but the Soulward Seal held. The stone stays: {{to}}.
localeEntries./depth/soul/stock/combine: {{shards}} Dragon Eye Shards into {{eyes}} Dragon Eye
localeEntries./depth/soul/stock/confirm: Dismantle {{name}}? The stone is gone for good, and you get {{dust}} Soul Dust.
localeEntries./depth/soul/stock/confirmEmpty: Its socket is still empty: put it in and you can refine it.
localeEntries./depth/soul/shop/items/blessing/text: +10 points to a refine chance, at most two per attempt.
localeEntries./depth/soul/shop/items/ward/text: On failure the stone does not drop. Used only on failure.
localeEntries./depth/soul/shop/items/eye/text: Needed for grade-change steps, used only on success.
localeEntries./depth/soul/shop/baseWeek: At base price this week: {{left}} more.
localeEntries./depth/soul/shop/risingDay: The next one is {{next}} SC; at the daily rollover ({{at}}) it resets to the base price ({{base}} SC).
localeEntries./depth/soul/shop/risingDayNoBase: The next one is {{next}} SC; at the daily rollover ({{at}}) it resets to the base price.
localeEntries./depth/soul/shop/risingWeek: The next one is {{next}} SC; at the weekly rollover ({{at}}) it resets to the base price ({{base}} SC).
localeEntries./depth/soul/shop/risingWeekNoBase: The next one is {{next}} SC; at the weekly rollover ({{at}}) it resets to the base price.
localeEntries./depth/soul/shop/limitOutDay: Daily limit reached ({{max}}). Back at the daily rollover ({{at}}).
localeEntries./depth/soul/shop/limitOutWeek: Weekly limit reached ({{max}}). Back at the weekly rollover ({{at}}).
localeEntries./depth/soul/essence/packBase: For Storm Coins. At base price today: {{left}}
localeEntries./depth/soul/essence/packOut: Sold out for today. Back at the daily rollover ({{at}}).
localeEntries./depth/soul/essence/houseOut: Your share for today is used up. Back at the daily rollover ({{at}}).
localeEntries./depth/soul/essence/catchUp: Catch-up: your sources give {{pct}}% more essence until {{date}}.
localeEntries./depth/soul/essence/houseNone: The Triple Seal isn't selling it right now. Fresh goods arrive every four hours.
localeEntries./depth/errors/socket_taken: This socket already has a stone.
localeEntries./depth/errors/socket_empty: This socket is empty: put a raw stone in it first.
localeEntries./depth/errors/no_raw_stone: You have no such raw stone.
localeEntries./depth/errors/not_enough_essence: Not enough essence for this stone.
localeEntries./depth/errors/not_enough_eyes: This step needs a Dragon Eye.
localeEntries./depth/errors/stale_state: The stone changed in the meantime. We refreshed it, please check again.
localeEntries./depth/errors/contract_locked: The Alchemist Contract is available from level 55.
localeEntries./depth/errors/contract_limit: You can buy it at most 60 days ahead.
localeEntries./depth/errors/contract_inactive: You have no active Alchemist Contract.
localeEntries./depth/errors/already_claimed: You have already collected today's share.
localeEntries./depth/errors/ess_limit: You've reached today's limit for this essence pack.
localeEntries./depth/errors/dust_limit: You've reached today's limit for Soul Dust packs.
localeEntries./depth/errors/eye_limit: You've reached this week's limit for Dragon Eyes.
localeEntries./depth/errors/house_limit: Your share of this essence at the Triple Seal is used up for today.
localeEntries./depth/errors/price_changed: The price changed in the meantime. Check the new one and try again.
localeEntries./depth/errors/house_not_selling: The Triple Seal isn't selling it right now. Check back after the next restock.
localeEntries./depth/contract/locked: The contract is available from level {{level}}.
localeEntries./depth/contract/inactive: You have no Alchemist Contract right now.
localeEntries./depth/contract/perkDaily: {{dust}} Soul Dust and {{blessing}} Alchemist's Blessing every day for {{days}} days
localeEntries./depth/contract/claimLabel: Collect today's share: {{dust}} Soul Dust and {{blessing}} Alchemist's Blessing
localeEntries./depth/contract/notes/claim: You collect the daily share in the game, here or in Today's tasks.
localeEntries./depth/contract/notes/missed: A missed day is lost, it does not pile up.
localeEntries./depth/contract/notes/extend: Bought again, the days are added to the end, at most {{days}} days ahead.
localeEntries./depth/contract/receipt/paid: +{{coins}} Storm Coins arrived. The contract's daily share now waits for you every day.
localeEntries./depth/contract/receipt/pending: The payment is in progress. As soon as it is confirmed, we credit the contract.
localeEntries./depth/contract/receipt/claimed: Today's share: +{{dust}} Soul Dust and +{{blessing}} Alchemist's Blessing.
localeEntries./depth/offers/essence: Refining also needs the stone's essence: it drops in play (the Stormheart shows where), the Triple Seal sells it for nyang, and you can buy it in essence packs for Storm Coins.
localeEntries./depth/today/soul_refine/where: The Stormheart tab at the alchemist, in town.
localeEntries./depth/today/soul_refine/ready: You have a stone to refine and the materials for it.
localeEntries./depth/today/soul_refine/short: Stones in sockets: {{stones}}. The next attempt needs more materials.
localeEntries./depth/today/alch_contract/where: The Alchemist Contract card on the Storm Coin page.
localeEntries./depth/today/alch_contract/ready: Collect today's Soul Dust and blessing. {{days}} days left.
localeEntries./depth/scroll/buyLabel: {{name}} as a decor scroll, {{coins}} Storm Coins
localeEntries./depth/scroll/bought: Bought: {{name}} decor scroll. You'll find it in your inventory.
localeEntries./depth/scroll/tip: Use it from your inventory and the decor is yours for good.
localeEntries./discord/lead: Link your Discord account to your game account. Every linked account gets the Stormcaller title and {{amount}} Nyang. If you joined our Discord before the launch on 31 October, the Day One Stormer badge is yours too, forever.
localeEntries./discord/privacy: We only read your Discord username, the date you joined our server and whether you boost it. You can unlink any time.
localeEntries./discord/needHero: Create or choose a hero first: the Nyang goes to your active hero.
localeEntries./discord/guest: Save your account first, then you can link your Discord.
localeEntries./discord/rewarded: The linking reward is already yours. Linking again does not give it a second time.
localeEntries./discord/boostHint: Boost our Discord server with Nitro and all your heroes get the Stormbooster title.
localeEntries./discord/boostActive: Stormbooster: thanks for boosting our server! The title is yours while you boost.
localeEntries./discord/unlinkConfirm: Unlink your Discord? The title and the badge stay yours, but linking again will not give the reward a second time.
localeEntries./discord/linked: Your Discord is linked. Welcome among the Stormers!
localeEntries./discord/reward/lead: Thanks for linking your Discord. Here is what you got:
localeEntries./discord/errors/taken: This Discord account is already linked to another game account.
localeEntries./discord/errors/alreadyLinked: Your game account already has a linked Discord. Unlink it first.
localeEntries./discord/errors/expired: The link expired or was already used. Please start again.
localeEntries./discord/errors/cancelled: Linking was cancelled on Discord. Nothing changed.
localeEntries./discord/errors/unavailable: Discord is not answering right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
localeEntries./discord/errors/rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a minute.
localeEntries./discord/milestone/lead: Members on our Discord at launch: {{members}}. Every hero gets the unlocked rewards. Yours:
localeEntries./discord/giveaway/notEligible: This giveaway is for players in Turkey (Discord is not available there). Join on our Discord!
localeEntries./discord/giveaway/guest: Save your account to join the giveaway.
localeEntries./discord/giveaway/unverified: Confirm your email address to join the giveaway.
localeEntries./discord/giveaway/noHero: Choose a hero to join the giveaway.
localeEntries./discord/giveaway/failed: The giveaway could not be loaded.
localeEntries./doll/figure: Full-body figure of {{name}} in the equipped gear
localeEntries./doll/weapon/emptyHint: Bare-handed? Grab a weapon at the shop.
localeEntries./doll/weapon/toShop: Weapon: empty. Go to the shop
localeEntries./dungeon/lore/monkey: An overgrown jungle ruin where the monkeys decided long ago that adventurers are just bigger bananas. The Banana King sits on the throne and hates being disturbed.
localeEntries./dungeon/lore/spider: A damp cave with silk in every corner, and in the silk, something that used to be an adventurer. Deep inside, the Silk Queen spins her plans, and her dinner.
localeEntries./dungeon/lore/dragon: A volcanic cave where even the rocks sweat. A young dragon nests here, still learning how much it enjoys breathing fire. It enjoys it a lot.
localeEntries./dungeon/lore/wild: An old bear den past the Village Outskirts, where the local wolves and poachers from Highwayman Country moved in at the same time and still can't agree whose place it is. Deep inside sleeps the Mossback Bear Lord, who says both tenants owe him rent.
localeEntries./dungeon/entry/intro: Ten rooms with the boss at the end, who also gives Feats from level {{level}}. A key lets you in, and your HP carries over from room to room.
localeEntries./dungeon/entry/introV2: Ten rooms with the boss at the end, who also gives Feats from level {{level}}. Your companion's eggs, evolution cores and skill books drop here, and after the boss a chest of XP and nyang waits.
localeEntries./dungeon/entry/lockedHint: Until then, hunt, break stones and take your weapon to the blacksmith.
localeEntries./dungeon/select/intro: Pick where you descend. Only one run can be active at a time.
localeEntries./dungeon/select/firstClearDone: First clear Storm Coins already earned
localeEntries./dungeon/select/items: Guaranteed item from the miniboss and the boss
localeEntries./dungeon/select/itemsV2: Guaranteed item from the miniboss and the boss, at your level
localeEntries./dungeon/select/freeKey: A free key is waiting today
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/hpLabel: Your hero's HP in this run
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/retreatText: The run ends and the key is not refunded. Your best room is kept, and so is every reward you have earned.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/enterHint: Uses one key. The run starts with full HP.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/claimHint: One free key per dungeon every day.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/claimHintV2: {{free}} free keys a day, for the dungeon where you take them. If you don't take them that day, they are gone at midnight, and you can hold at most {{free}} free keys at a time.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/claimed: No more free keys today (you took them, or you already hold {{free}}). New ones come in {{time}}.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/buyLeft_one: You can buy {{count}} more key here today.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/buyLeft_other: You can buy {{count}} more keys here today.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/buyLimit: No more keys for sale today. Buy again in {{time}}.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/noKey: You have no key. Take the daily key or buy one with Storm Coins.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/bagSpace: A run needs at least {{count}} free bag slots, you have {{free}}: the miniboss and the boss always drop an item.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/otherRun: Only one run at a time. Finish or abandon this one first: {{name}}.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/itemRoom: This room drops a guaranteed item, so you need a free inventory slot.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/bagFull: Your inventory is full. Sell or equip something before facing the boss.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/buffTip: Lasts until the next boss: {{name}} (room {{room}}), its fight included.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/chestGoalTip: Win all 10 rooms and this chest is yours at the end. Every room you win pays its own reward.
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/chestHint: The boss is down: the chest is yours
localeEntries./dungeon/hall/lootTip: What this run has given you so far: it is already yours, and it stays yours if you retreat or lose.
localeEntries./dungeon/summary/clearedLine: You defeated {{boss}}. All {{total}} rooms are yours.
localeEntries./dungeon/summary/keyRefunded: Your free daily key came back, so you can have another go today.
localeEntries./dungeon/summary/leftLine: You made it out in one piece. Rooms cleared: {{done}}/{{total}}.
localeEntries./dungeon/summary/noLoot: No items from this run. Only experience, and that does not fit in a bag anyway.
localeEntries./dungeon/summary/noLootV2: No items from this run. The rooms' XP and nyang are yours anyway.
localeEntries./dungeon/summary/partial: Rewards from rooms before the page was reloaded are not listed here, but they are yours.
localeEntries./dungeon/summary/again_one: You still have {{count}} key, come back any time.
localeEntries./dungeon/summary/again_other: You still have {{count}} keys, come back any time.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/rooms: 10 rooms: eight dungeon creatures, a miniboss in room 5 and the boss in room 10.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/perRoom: XP and nyang in every room
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/items: The miniboss and the boss drop a guaranteed item of level {{min}}-{{max}}, +0 to +4, with bonuses.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/rules: Your HP carries over from room to room, and you drink potions on your own during fights. A defeat ends the run, your best room is kept.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/rulesV2: Your HP carries over from room to room, and you drink at most {{cap}} potions in a run, on your own during fights. A defeat ends the run, your best room is kept.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/keyHow: One free key per dungeon every day, more for {{coins}} SC (at most {{max}} a day). Entering uses one.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/keyHowV2: {{free}} free keys a day; if you don't take them that day, they are gone at midnight, and you can hold at most {{free}}. More for {{coins}} SC (at most {{max}} a day). Entering uses one.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/hp: Your run HP carries over from room to room. Only potions heal you, during fights.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/potions: You drink them on your own when your HP runs low in a fight. The shop sells more.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/potionsV2: You drink them on your own when your HP runs low in a fight, at most {{cap}} in a run. The shop sells more.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/retreat: The run ends and the key is lost. Your best room is kept.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/enter: Uses one key. The run starts with full HP from room {{room}}.
localeEntries./dungeon/tip/lockedLine: You can enter from level {{level}}. You are level {{now}}.
localeEntries./dungeon/trophy/from: Feats from the boss from level {{level}}
localeEntries./dungeon/trophy/done: Today's Feat is yours, more tomorrow
localeEntries./dungeon/trophy/missed: Feat: {{pct}}% chance (low-level dungeon), not this time.
localeEntries./dungeon/errors/no_key: You have no key for this dungeon.
localeEntries./dungeon/errors/run_active: A run is already active. Finish or abandon it first.
localeEntries./dungeon/errors/no_run: There is no active run in this dungeon.
localeEntries./dungeon/errors/level_too_low: This dungeon needs a higher level.
localeEntries./dungeon/errors/buy_limit: No more keys for sale today.
localeEntries./dungeon/errors/inventory_full: Your inventory is full: the boss item needs a free slot.
localeEntries./dungeon/errors/bag_space: A run needs at least two free bag slots.
localeEntries./dungeon/errors/no_chest: There is no chest to open in this dungeon right now.
localeEntries./dungeon/errors/chest_pending: Open the chest first: the boss is already down.
localeEntries./dungeon/errors/room_not_fight: This room is not a fight right now. Make your choice in the room first.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/curse/desc/tough_short: Bosses have +10% life and fights are 30% shorter.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/curse/desc/potions_only: Only potions heal: life steal and healing skills do nothing.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/curse/desc/fury: Bosses hit 40% harder but have 20% less life.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/curse/desc/dry: No potions in this dungeon. In return bosses hit 15% softer.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/doors/hint: Pick one door. The next room's fight waits either way.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/door/treasure/lock: A locked chest: pick the lock. The better you do, the more you get.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/door/treasure/cracks: Stone Splitting: split the stormstone in two. The better you do, the more you get.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/door/treasure/plain: A treasure chest waits behind this door.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/door/trap/line: You lose {{pct}}% HP, but the loot is richer.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/door/pet/line: {{pet}} fights alone and cannot lose: +{{xp}} companion XP.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/door/golden/line: A rare guest: you fight it in the next room. Tougher, but richer loot.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/door/hidden/line: A rare guest: a treasure room with double loot.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/treasure/openHint: Without the game you get the smallest loot.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/pet/atCap: {{pet}}: at its level cap, no companion XP for now
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/deeper/line: Below the boss waits a bonus floor. Win: the chest +{{bonus}}% and an extra boss item. Fall: you lose the run chest.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/deeper/confirmText: If you fall on the bonus floor, the run chest is lost. The rewards of your rooms and the boss stay.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/deeper/won: You beat the bonus floor: the chest +{{bonus}}%.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/deeper/lost: You fell on the bonus floor. The run chest is lost.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/errors/room_not_fight: Decide first: a door or a treasure room is waiting.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/errors/no_doors: There is no door to choose now.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/errors/treasure_playing: The game is still open: finish it first.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/errors/no_chest: There is no chest to push deeper for.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/errors/no_run: There is no run in this dungeon any more.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/errors/request_id_reused: This request clashed with an earlier one. Try again.
localeEntries./dungeon/spice/errors/bad_door: There is no such door. Pick one of the doors shown.
localeEntries./endgame/cityTexts/npc/fisherman/greetin: Quiet now, the fish can hear you. If you came to fish, sit down, the bait is in the box.
localeEntries./endgame/cityTexts/npc/fisherman/ask: Will you teach me to fish?
localeEntries./endgame/cityTexts/npc/fisherman/line: Cast it, then watch the float. When it dips, strike, but not a moment before! An impatient man only feeds the fish.
localeEntries./endgame/cityTexts/npc/fisherman/locked: Sit down if you are tired. I let people fish from level ten; until then the fish are resting too.
localeEntries./endgame/cityTexts/city/placeHints/fishe: Fishing: fish, bait and the fishing log
localeEntries./endgame/season/intro: A season lasts two weeks. At the end you are rewarded by rank, and your honour moves a quarter of the way back towards a thousand.
localeEntries./endgame/season/rules: You need at least {{min}} attacks to be ranked. Defending changes your honour too, but only attacking moves you up.
localeEntries./endgame/season/historyEmpty: No season has closed yet. The current one ends: {{date}}.
localeEntries./endgame/season/weeklyLead: At the end of every week we record the top hundred.
localeEntries./endgame/season/weeklyEmpty: The first weekly board is made at the end of the week.
localeEntries./endgame/heroic/lead: The same dungeon, but its tenants have been working out. Better items, rare forge aids, once a week.
localeEntries./endgame/heroic/lockedClear: Clear it in normal mode first.
localeEntries./endgame/heroic/weekly: Can be cleared once a week.
localeEntries./endgame/heroic/loot: +2 to +7 items, Stormstone Shards, sometimes Ashward Scrolls, Luck Ore or Stormstone Dust
localeEntries./endgame/heroic/firstClearDone: You already got the first heroic clear reward
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/lead: The whole village hits it. Your damage adds up, and everyone who struck at least once gets a reward.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/taunts/wb_grizzly: I slept all winter. Now I am hungry, and you are small.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/taunts/wb_ruin: I waited under the sand for a thousand years. I have time, but I do not like it.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/taunts/wb_frost: Cold? I have only introduced myself.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/taunts/wb_flame: Who left the gate open? Never mind, it is burning anyway.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/defeatedLine: The boss has fallen! Your reward is ready.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/defeatedOver: The boss has fallen. A new boss comes next week.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/noAttacks: No attacks left today. Come back tomorrow.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/noHits: You have not attacked this week.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/guildOn: {{count}} guildmates hit it: the bonus is on.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/guildOff: {{count}}/{{min}} guildmates hit it. Once you are all there, everyone gets a bonus.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/topEmpty: Nobody has attacked yet. Be the first!
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/undefeated: If it does not fall by the end of the week, half the reward is given, without Storm Coins or the title.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/soulNote: From level {{level}} the weekly boss also gives Stormheart materials: the essence goes to your weakest stone, the raw stone to a new socket. If the boss is not defeated, you get half of these too.
localeEntries./endgame/worldboss/claimDone: You claimed your weekly boss reward.
localeEntries./endgame/storm/lead: There are twenty more floors above the Stormcatcher's roof. The Landlord rents them out to new tenants every week, so you can start again every Monday.
localeEntries./endgame/storm/done: You are at the top this week. New tenants move in on Monday.
localeEntries./endgame/storm/topEmpty: Nobody has climbed yet this week.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/lead: Nakshi's pier. Pick the water and the bait, cast, and strike when you get a bite!
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/locked: Nakshi lets you on the pier from level {{level}}.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/sinkNote: Fishing isn't a way to earn money: fish are worth it in trades ({{items}}). Sold, they only bring back part of the bait's price.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/saleEstimate: Sells for ~{{nyang}} nyang per bait on average
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/buyHint: You can carry at most {{max}} of each kind.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/moreCatches/tip: Raises today's catch limit. The price doubles with each purchase in a day and resets at the daily reset.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/outcome/early: Too early, the fish got scared.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/outcome/late: Too late, the fish nibbled the bait off.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/limit: That is enough for today. There will be fish tomorrow.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/extra/note: You've had today's catches, but Nakshi lets you keep going: an extra catch costs {{energy}} energy ({{left}} left).
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/extra/noEnergy: An extra catch needs {{energy}} energy. Take a breather, the fish will wait.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/extra/done: You've caught all of today's extras too. There'll be fish tomorrow.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/noBait: No bait. Buy some from the box!
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/oddsHint: The bait and the time of day decide what bites.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/creelEmpty: The bucket is empty. Catch something! A boot counts too.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/baits/bait_worm/desc: Cheap and honest. Most fish are not picky.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/baits/bait_shrimp/desc: Rarer fish like it too. Twice the chance of a special one.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/baits/bait_storm/desc: Carved from stormstone, it sizzles in the water. Legends come out for it.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/baits/bait_wonder/desc: 5 pieces of tier-four bait: rare and epic fish practically jump into the bucket.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_bleak/desc: Small, quick, and always the first to eat the bait.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_carp/desc: Admires itself in every scale. It is pleased.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_moonkoi/desc: Only rises at night, when the moon looks into the water too.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_roach/desc: Its eyes are red, but not from crying.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_pike/desc: Hungriest at dawn and dusk, but never says no in between. It hunts you too.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_goldcat/desc: The bandits say it used to be their boss. The catfish denies it.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_trout/desc: In such a hurry that it sometimes beats the hook.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_tusk/desc: Learned the grumpy look from the orcs.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_totem/desc: The shamans carved it, then dropped it in the water. It survived.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_sandperch/des: Squints even in the oasis. Too much sun.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_mummy/desc: Resting in its wraps for a thousand years. It would rather not be disturbed.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_ruffe/desc: Shivering, but it will not stop swimming.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_hairycat/desc: The yetis say it is family. The catfish say it is not.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_crystal/desc: Sparkles best at dawn. A shame to eat it.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_emberbream/de: Comes out of the water already grilled.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_lavaeel/desc: Hides under the ash by day so the sun will not burn it. It is made of lava. Ironic.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_phoenix/desc: Let it go and it hatches again at dawn. You will not let it go.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_stormcarp/des: The water flashes with lightning at night when it is near. Legendary.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/fish_dragonkoi/des: The Storm Dragon's favourite fish. They say it talks, just rarely.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/fish/junk_boot/desc: Looking for the other one? Do not.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/auto/bigBite: A big one is on the line!
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/auto/hintBig: Common and rare fish always land. If an epic or legendary fish bites, Nakshi stops and you play that fight yourself.
localeEntries./endgame/fishing/cupCasts: Contest casts: {{left}}/{{max}}, not from your daily catches

localeEntries./endgame/today/tower_storm/top: This week's peak is done. Again on Monday.
localeEntries./endgame/today/fishing_cup/soon: Today between {{from}} and {{to}}: your biggest fish counts.
localeEntries./endgame/today/fishing_cup/where: Nakshi's pier in the village, the Contest tab.
localeEntries./endgame/errors/no_energy: Not enough energy for an extra catch.
localeEntries./endgame/errors/level_too_low: You need a higher level for this.
localeEntries./endgame/errors/cast_active: Your line is already in. Wait for the bite!
localeEntries./endgame/errors/too_early: Not yet, the fish is still fighting!
localeEntries./endgame/errors/bait_full: You cannot carry that much bait.
localeEntries./endgame/errors/not_tradable: Even Nakshi does not want that. Fair enough.
localeEntries./endgame/errors/set_incomplete: The collection is not complete yet.
localeEntries./endgame/errors/boss_defeated: The boss fell in the meantime. Check your reward!
localeEntries./endgame/errors/no_boss: The weekly boss has not arrived yet. Refresh!
localeEntries./endgame/errors/heroic_locked: You already cleared it in heroic mode this week.
localeEntries./endgame/errors/not_cleared: Clear it in normal mode first.
localeEntries./endgame/errors/storm_week_done: You are at the top this week.
localeEntries./endgame/errors/unknown_week: There is no board for that week.
localeEntries./endgame/errors/mutator_closed: The Storm Curse is not running now. A new one starts on Monday.
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/cardLine: A known boss every week with a new curse. A board per world.
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/closed: The first Storm Curse starts on Monday: {{date}}
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/noAttempts: No attempts left today. Back tomorrow.
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/scoreRule: Your best attempt counts: damage in thousandths of the boss's life. A kill is 1000 points plus {{bonus}} for every turn left.
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/rewardTop: At the close the top {{top}} earn the Curse-Breaker title, the top {{elite}} Lord of the Storm Curse.
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/rewardAll: Everyone who fights: {{shards}} Stormstone Shards and {{nyang}} nyang, claimable after the week.
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/result/fought: {{score}} points: you took {{pct}}% of its life.
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/curses/tough_short/desc: The boss has +10% life and the fight is 30% shorter.
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/curses/potions_only/des: Only potions heal: life steal and healing skills do nothing.
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/curses/fury/desc: The boss hits 40% harder but has 20% less life.
localeEntries./endgame/mutator/curses/dry/desc: No potions in this fight. In return the boss hits 15% softer.
localeEntries./events/hud/tipOpen: Click to open the Events panel and the shop.
localeEntries./events/hud/graceTip: The holiday is over, but you can still spend your tokens until the shop closes.
localeEntries./events/hud/previewTip: The holiday shop opens at level {{level}}. What you collect until then is kept ({{token}}: {{value}} so far).
localeEntries./events/hud/previewTip_halloween_one: The Lantern Shop and the Dead Stone open at level {{level}}. You are already collecting Wisp Lanterns: {{count}} is waiting for you.
localeEntries./events/hud/previewTip_halloween_other: The Lantern Shop and the Dead Stone open at level {{level}}. You are already collecting Wisp Lanterns: {{count}} are waiting for you.
localeEntries./events/hud/previewLabel: Holiday: {{name}}. Opens at level {{level}}; its rewards already collect.
localeEntries./events/hud/tipOpenNoShop: Click to open the Events panel.
localeEntries./events/effect/xp: +{{pct}}% experience from every fight and the hunting bag
localeEntries./events/effect/forge: +{{pct}}% chance on every upgrade at the smith (the cap stays)
localeEntries./events/effect/portya: At the end of a foray, another chest opens next to the one you pick
localeEntries./events/effect/package_coins: Double Storm Coins on the base coins of packages
localeEntries./events/effect/holiday: Collect {{token}} tokens by playing and trade them in the holiday shop
localeEntries./events/effect/holiday_boss: Weekend boss fight: one free try a day
localeEntries./events/templates/black_friday/desc: While it lasts, you get 50% more coins from Storm Coin packs.
localeEntries./events/templates/hazaterok/desc: Stonewall Fair: everyone who comes back gets a double gift. Break stones together for the world's shared goal; every tier rewards everyone.
localeEntries./events/templates/sarkanyisten_aldasa/de: The Storm Dragon watches over the Stormbreakers: every battle teaches more this weekend.
localeEntries./events/templates/kincsvadasz_napok/desc: Stones and monsters drop more loot. Now is the time to come home with a full bag.
localeEntries./events/templates/nyangeso/desc: The merchants are in a good mood: all loot and rewards are worth more nyang.
localeEntries./events/templates/kovacsunnep/desc: On the smiths' feast day even the hammer is luckier. Time for the big upgrades.
localeEntries./events/templates/kovacsora/desc: For two hours the Time Gate opens above the forge: every upgrade has a better chance.
localeEntries./events/templates/vezerek_ejszakaja/desc: The map warlords will not rest tonight: you get more attempts against them.
localeEntries./events/templates/vezerek_oraja/desc: For two hours the Time Gate opens before the warlords' den: one more attempt.
localeEntries./events/templates/vezerek_hetvegeje/desc: The map warlords roam all weekend: two more attempts against them every day.
localeEntries./events/templates/kalmarok_vasara/desc: Travelling merchants hold a fair: at the end of a foray another chest opens beside your pick.
localeEntries./events/templates/nyitott_kapuk/desc: The dungeon guards are lenient: one more free key for every dungeon.
localeEntries./events/templates/sarkanykincs/desc: While it lasts, you get 25% more coins from Storm Coin packs.
localeEntries./events/templates/halloween/desc: The dead stones glow again. Break them, collect Wisp Lanterns and light your lantern for the emperor.
localeEntries./events/templates/mikulas/desc: Socks hang on the fences of the winter road. Collect them, and Santa's sleigh brings rewards.
localeEntries./events/templates/karacsony/desc: The kingdoms lay down their arms for a few days. Collect baubles, gifts wait under the pine.
localeEntries./events/templates/szilveszter/desc: In the last days of the year firework rockets fall among the stones. Collect them and celebrate!
localeEntries./events/templates/valentin/desc: Cranes are the sign of faithfulness. Collect crane pendants and trade them at the lovers' fair.
localeEntries./events/templates/kilencfarku/desc: Hwaryeon, the Nine-Tailed, roams the hills. She only shows herself at weekends.
localeEntries./events/templates/elso_vihar/desc: While it lasts, you get 50% more coins from Storm Coin packs.
localeEntries./events/templates/teli_vasar/desc: While it lasts, you get 30% more coins from Storm Coin packs.
localeEntries./events/templates/kegyes_napok/name: The Storm Dragon's Days of Favour
localeEntries./events/templates/kegyes_napok/desc: After the Night of the Dead Stones the Storm Dragon watches over the Stormbreakers for three days: every battle teaches more.
localeEntries./events/panel/lead: A different event runs every week: double loot, nyang rain, forge luck, Time Gates.
localeEntries./events/panel/none: No event is running right now. The fair merchants are busy folding their tents.
localeEntries./events/panel/noneNext: No event is scheduled for the next two weeks yet.
localeEntries./events/shop/todayFull: You have today's {{max}} tokens. Collect again tomorrow.
localeEntries./events/shop/grace: The holiday is over, no more tokens. The shop stays open until {{date}}.
localeEntries./events/shop/limitTip: You can buy it at most {{limit}} times during the holiday.
localeEntries./events/shop/titleTip: Your title shows under your name on your profile. Wear it on the Storm Road page, at the bottom, under “Titles, frames and backgrounds”.
localeEntries./events/offers/event_halloween/desc: Holiday pack for the Night of the Dead Stones: Storm Coins, nyang, bond thread, forge supplies and the Silk Lantern frame.
localeEntries./events/offers/event_halloween/line: Only during the Night of the Dead Stones, once.
localeEntries./events/offers/launch_halloween/desc: To celebrate the launch: Storm Coins, the Nine-Tailed Fox mount for 30 days, 7 days of Imperial Pass and Ashward Scrolls.
localeEntries./events/offers/launch_halloween/line: Only during the Night of the Dead Stones, once.
localeEntries./events/offers/event_mikulas/desc: From Santa's sack: Storm Coins, a companion egg, Ashward Scrolls and potions.
localeEntries./events/offers/event_karacsony/desc: From under the pine: Storm Coins, nyang, a companion egg, Luck Ore, Stormstone Dust and Ashward Scrolls.
localeEntries./events/offers/event_szilveszter/desc: For the end of the year: Storm Coins, a patience scroll, Luck Ore and Ashward Scrolls.
localeEntries./events/offers/event_valentin/desc: For the Lovers' Festival: Storm Coins, a companion egg, Ashward Scrolls and Luck Ore.
localeEntries./events/errors/insufficient_tokens: You need more tokens for this. Keep collecting by playing!
localeEntries./events/errors/limit_reached: You cannot buy more of this during the holiday.
localeEntries./events/errors/unknown_item: This item is not in the shop. We refreshed the list.
localeEntries./events/portyaBonus: Merchants' Fair: you got this one too!
localeEntries./events/twitchDrops/watch: Watch Stonestorm streams on Twitch: every week, 1, 2, 6, 10, 14 and 15 hours of watching each earn a chest.
localeEntries./events/twitchDrops/brew: The 14-hour chest holds the Twitch-only Stormwatcher's Brew: +15% XP, nyang and loot for 1 day.
localeEntries./events/twitchDrops/open: Click and link your Twitch account (you only do it once).
localeEntries./expedition/reroll/hint: You get three new offers in place of these. The first reroll of the day is free.
localeEntries./expedition/travel/arrivedHint: The stone is already cracking. Hit it before it changes its mind.
localeEntries./expedition/travel/arrivedAnnounce: You've arrived at {{name}}. Time to fight.
localeEntries./expedition/travel/skipHint: You get there right away. The price follows the foray's energy: you pay for the part still ahead, every door has a minimum price, and it costs the same in one go or door by door.
localeEntries./expedition/travel/onFoot: You're on foot. Rent a mount at the stable to get there sooner.
localeEntries./expedition/travel/riding: Riding the {{mount}}: the trip is {{percent}} shorter.
localeEntries./expedition/refill/limit: All {{perDay}} refills used today. More at the daily rollover ({{at}}).
localeEntries./expedition/refill/full: Your energy is at the cap ({{cap}}), it can't go higher now.
localeEntries./expedition/refill/tipText: +{{amount}} energy for {{coins}} Storm Coins, up to {{perDay}} times a day.
localeEntries./expedition/refill/tipCap: With bought energy you can have at most {{cap}}.
localeEntries./expedition/refill/overcapTip: Extra refills above the daily limit: {{max}} a day, in turn {{ladder}} SC.
localeEntries./expedition/errors/expedition_active: You're already on a foray. Finish that one first.
localeEntries./expedition/errors/offer_not_found: This offer is gone. We refreshed the list.
localeEntries./expedition/errors/not_ready: You're not there yet. Wait a little, or skip.
localeEntries./expedition/errors/no_expedition: You're not on the road right now. We refreshed your status.
localeEntries./expedition/errors/already_arrived: You've already arrived, there's nothing to skip.
localeEntries./expedition/errors/energy_full: Your energy is at the cap, it can't go higher now.
localeEntries./expedition/errors/size_locked: This foray isn't open to you yet: it opens at a higher level.
localeEntries./expedition/tip/base: Rewards without boosts and item bonuses; with them you get more.
localeEntries./expedition/quick/tip: Fresh legs: in your first 3 days every short foray, and after that the first 12 each day, reaches the stone in half the time.
localeEntries./expedition/story/tip: Your story chapter asks for this stone.
localeEntries./expedition/story/questTip: Your side quest asks for this stone.
localeEntries./expedition/longNote: You can't start another foray in the meantime.
localeEntries./expedition/leftover/text: Spends your last {{energy}} energy. Trip: {{time}}. Pays XP and nyang only.
localeEntries./expedition/leftover/startLabel: Set out on a short foray with {{energy}} energy
localeEntries./expedition/leftover/travel: You're on a short foray and will be back soon.
localeEntries./expedition/leftover/arrived: You're back from the short foray. Collect your reward!
localeEntries./fishing2/fight/holdHint: Press and hold: mouse, space or finger
localeEntries./fishing2/fight/pull: Reel in, the line is slack!
localeEntries./fishing2/fight/ease: Let go! It's making a run!
localeEntries./fishing2/fight/zone/slack: Slack, the fish could slip off
localeEntries./fishing2/outcome/hooked: Fish on! Hold while it rests, let go when it runs.
localeEntries./fishing2/outcome/snapped: The line snapped and the fish swam off with your bait.
localeEntries./fishing2/outcome/escaped: The hook slipped and the fish swam off with your bait.
localeEntries./fishing2/auto/hintOn: Common and rare fish always land, special and legendary ones {{pct}}% of the time. Play it by hand and every fish can be yours.
localeEntries./fishing2/auto/hintOff: You're reeling by hand. Switch this on and Nakshi does the work, and you can cast several times at once.
localeEntries./fishing2/auto/stopped/no_energy: Not enough energy for an extra catch.
localeEntries./fishing2/auto/stopped/extra_confirm: Today's free catches are used up.
localeEntries./fishing2/auto/extraAsk/title: Today's {{count}} free catches are used up
localeEntries./fishing2/auto/extraAsk/text: From here, every extra catch costs {{energy}} energy (up to {{left}} more today). Should Nakshi keep fishing on auto?
localeEntries./fishing2/auto/paidAsk/title: Nakshi's {{count}} free catches for today are used up
localeEntries./fishing2/auto/paidAsk/text: From here every auto catch costs {{energy}} energy. By hand, {{free}} more catches are free today. Should Nakshi keep reeling?
localeEntries./fishing2/master/starTip: Master Catch: you kept it in the green the whole time
localeEntries./fishing2/feed/fish_legend: {{name}} landed a legendary fish: $t(endgame:fishing.fish.{{fish}}.name), {{kg, number}} kg!
localeEntries./fishing2/trade/logHint: You can look it up later at the bottom of the Bucket, under Recent trades.
localeEntries./fishing2/log/empty: You haven't traded with Nakshi yet. Whatever you get from trades or gutting shows up here too.
localeEntries./fishing2/log/note: Nakshi keeps a note of your last {{max}} trades.
localeEntries./fishing2/gear/note: The item went into your inventory, in the first free slot.

localeEntries./gear/support/capOverFull: cap {{cap}}, already reached without this item ({{total}} in total)
