localeEntries./gear/unique/desc/stun: Each hit has a {{v}} chance to stun the enemy, so it skips its next attack{{alt}}.
localeEntries./gear/unique/desc/shell: The first {{v}} hits you take deal {{cut}} less damage{{alt}}.
localeEntries./gear/unique/desc/cadence: Every {{every}} attacks, the last one deals {{v}} more damage{{alt}}.
localeEntries./gear/unique/desc/thorns: The attacker takes {{v}} of the damage it deals to you{{alt}}.
localeEntries./gear/unique/arena: The effect does not work in the arena.
localeEntries./gear/compare/caption: The worn and the new item side by side
localeEntries./gear/bag/empty: Your bag is empty. Hunting and forays bring items.
localeEntries./gear/stash/fullNote: While it is full, the hunting bag can't be collected.
localeEntries./gear/stash/fewRoom: Best first: with little room, Heroic and Rare go first.
localeEntries./gear/stash/safe: Take them, or sell what you don't want.
localeEntries./gear/stash/quickHint: Unlocked Commons weaker than worn, from the bag and the Reserve.
localeEntries./gear/stash/pickTitle: What do you sell? Weakest first.
localeEntries./gear/stash/warnValuable: A Heroic or Mythic is picked: sell it anyway?
localeEntries./gear/hc/text: Your hero's strength in one number: damage and toughness together.
localeEntries./gear/hc/notChance: Combat Power is measured against a boss of your level. Whether you win is told by the chance before the fight; in the arena Dexterity counts for more than Combat Power shows.
localeEntries./gear/side/title: Where does your Combat Power come from?
localeEntries./gear/side/intro: Striped rows don't count in the rankings.
localeEntries./gear/vs/rule: Combat Power is measured against a boss of your level. Two heroes with the same Combat Power can face a boss or another player with very different chances: class, Dexterity and bonuses count too.
localeEntries./guest/start/hint: Jump straight in. Save your hero later and get 20 Storm Coins for it.
localeEntries./guest/start/errors/rate_limited: Too many new guests started from this network. Sign up, or try again in an hour.
localeEntries./guest/start/errors/guest_closed: Lots of people tried us today, so guest play opens again tomorrow. You can still sign up and play now.
localeEntries./guest/create/ready/lead: One tap and your first fight begins. You can change the name once for free later.
localeEntries./guest/create/diceTip: Roll the die for a new name nobody has taken yet.
localeEntries./guest/create/nameTaken: Someone just took that name. We rolled you another one.
localeEntries./guest/create/party/kingdomFree: Kingdoms are symbolic: you can play together from any of them.
localeEntries./guest/create/party/send: Send it to your friends: you land on the same world and become friends.
localeEntries./guest/create/party/shareText: Join me in Stonestorm! My party code: {{code}}
localeEntries./guest/badge/label: You are playing as a guest. Save your hero
localeEntries./guest/badge/tipText: Your hero only lives in this browser for now.
localeEntries./guest/badge/tipReward: Save it with an email and get 20 Storm Coins.
localeEntries./guest/save/intro/purchase: Only saved heroes can buy. Enter your email and a password, and we will carry on with your purchase.
localeEntries./guest/save/intro/guild: Only saved heroes can join a guild, so your guildmates can find you tomorrow too.
localeEntries./guest/save/intro/reminder: You have been with us for a day! Your hero only lives in this browser for now. Save it and play from anywhere.
localeEntries./guest/save/intro/settings: Your hero only lives in this browser for now. Save it and play from anywhere.
localeEntries./guest/save/intro/logout: Your guest hero only lives in this browser. Once you log out, you cannot get back to it. Save it first?
localeEntries./guest/save/intro/first_run: Nice foray! Your hero only lives in this browser for now. Save it in a minute and the loot stays yours on any device.
localeEntries./guest/save/intro/level5: Level 5 already! Don't lose your progress: save your hero and play from anywhere.
localeEntries./guest/save/intro/session: Welcome back! Your hero still only lives in this browser. Save it now so it is always waiting for you.
localeEntries./guest/save/intro/day0: Tomorrow your Travel Chest opens. Save your hero so it waits for you on any device.
localeEntries./guest/save/heroNameHint: Others will know you by this name.
localeEntries./guest/save/heroNameFree: You can still change it once for free later.
localeEntries./guest/save/fine: Your hero, items and progress all stay. From now on you log in with your email.
localeEntries./guest/save/doneText: You got your {{coins}} Storm Coins. You can now log in from any device with your email.
localeEntries./guest/save/errors/already_taken: There is already an account with this email. Log in with it, or use another one.
localeEntries./guest/save/discord/text: Join our Discord and link your account on the Account page here in the game: you get {{nyang}} nyang and a rare title, and your account is safer.
localeEntries./guest/save/atRisk: {{name}} (level {{level}}) lives only in this browser for now.
localeEntries./guest/note/text: You are playing as a guest: your hero only lives in this browser.
localeEntries./guest/account/tip: Guest account: the hero is not saved yet
localeEntries./guild/nav/lockedNote: Guilds take members from level {{level}}. Until then you only know them from tavern gossip.
localeEntries./guild/gate/text: You can found or join a guild from level {{level}}. You are level {{now}}, so off you go hunting.
localeEntries./guild/lobby/searchInvalid: Letters and digits only, no spaces, at most 16.
localeEntries./guild/lobby/empty: No guild by that name. Maybe it is waiting for you to found it.
localeEntries./guild/lobby/emptyAll: Your kingdom has no guilds yet. Be the first!
localeEntries./guild/lobby/appliedNote: They are reading your letter. Or having lunch.
localeEntries./guild/lobby/kingdomOnly: You can join any guild; your kingdom does not matter.
localeEntries./guild/lobby/activeBand: Members active in the last 3 days: {{band}}
localeEntries./guild/lobby/suggested/lead: An active guild with free slots you can join right now.
localeEntries./guild/lobby/suggested/none: No open guild you can join right now. See the recruiting guilds below.
localeEntries./guild/lobby/emptyOpen: No guild in your world has a free slot right now. Search by name, or found one!
localeEntries./guild/lobby/joinLimit: You can join at most {{max}} guilds an hour. Try again in {{time}}.
localeEntries./guild/lobby/appliedInstead: {{name}} switched to approval meanwhile, so your application was sent.
localeEntries./guild/found/intro: Your own guild, your own fortress, your own arguments. The founder becomes leader and hears all the complaints.
localeEntries./guild/found/nameInvalid: Use 3-16 letters or digits, no spaces or symbols.
localeEntries./guild/found/tagHint: 2-4 letters, shown next to your name.
localeEntries./guild/found/tagInvalid: Use 2-4 letters, no digits or spaces.
localeEntries./guild/found/emblemNote: The guild spirit draws your emblem at founding. There is no appeal.
localeEntries./guild/hall/fortressNext_one: {{count}} more building level to the next stage.
localeEntries./guild/hall/fortressNext_other: {{count}} more building levels to the next stage.
localeEntries./guild/hall/fortressMax: The fortress stands in full glory. The neighbours are jealous.
localeEntries./guild/hall/loadError: The guild details did not arrive.
localeEntries./guild/treasury/done: Thank you! The treasury is {{amount}} nyang richer, and so is your conscience.
localeEntries./guild/treasury/invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and {{max}}.
localeEntries./guild/buildings/max: A finished masterpiece, it will not get any prettier.
localeEntries./guild/buildings/officersOnly: Officers and the leader upgrade. You donate meanwhile.
localeEntries./guild/members/confirmKick/text: {{name}} stays out in the rain and the gate shuts behind them.
localeEntries./guild/members/confirmHandover/text: {{name}} becomes leader and you stay an officer. They hear the complaints from now on.
localeEntries./guild/members/confirmLeave/text: The gate shuts behind you and your donations stay inside.
localeEntries./guild/members/confirmLeave/textLeader: The gate shuts behind you and {{name}} becomes leader.
localeEntries./guild/members/confirmLeave/textLast: You are the last one out: the guild dissolves, treasury and buildings with it.
localeEntries./guild/members/invite/hint: You can invite heroes from your kingdom who are level 10 or higher and not in a guild.
localeEntries./guild/members/invite/invalid: Letters and numbers only, no spaces, 3 to 16 characters.
localeEntries./guild/members/invite/hintAny: You can invite any hero of level 10 or more without a guild, from any kingdom.
localeEntries./guild/members/invite/listHint: Heroes without a guild who played in the last 7 days, highest level first. Type the start of a name to narrow the list.
localeEntries./guild/members/invite/listEmpty: No hero found. Try another start of a name.
localeEntries./guild/members/invite/listInvalid: Letters and numbers only, no spaces.
localeEntries./guild/notice/hint: Only guild members see it. Save it empty to take it down.
localeEntries./guild/board/tooLong: At most {{max}} characters fit on the note.
localeEntries./guild/raid/fought: You vented your rage for today. Come back tomorrow.
localeEntries./guild/raid/defeated: The boss has fallen! The next one arrives tomorrow, well rested.
localeEntries./guild/raid/rules: One fight a day. When the boss falls everyone gets nyang and materials by damage dealt, and the treasury gets 10%.

localeEntries./halloween/story/lead: Every year, on the anniversary of the night of the stones, the dead stones glow again, not with the light of the storm, but with a cold, blue will-o'-the-wisp light.
localeEntries./halloween/story/custom: The old emperor lit a lantern for every fallen soldier. Tonight all three kingdoms do the same: break the dead stones before the fox reaches them.

localeEntries./loop/today/goalWhereForge: The blacksmith in town: strengthen your gear first.
localeEntries./loop/today/rows/patrol/where: On the Foray tab when you are out of energy.
localeEntries./loop/today/rows/boss_brave/where: The Boss tab on the Hunt page.
localeEntries./loop/today/rows/boss_chase/where: The Boss tab on the Hunt page.
localeEntries./loop/today/claimAllConflict: The list changed meanwhile. See what's left.
localeEntries./loop/today/bossBrave: Brave challenge: {{boss}} is still stronger than you. Beat it anyway for +{{pct}}% loot.
localeEntries./loop/mapOpen/line: Its monsters are for level {{level}} and up.
localeEntries./loop/mapOpen/danger: For now they are still dangerous for you.
localeEntries./loop/mapOpen/meanwhile: Until then {{boss}}'s family is waiting: set and Mythic, wearable from level {{itemLevel}}.
localeEntries./loop/errors/patrol_closed: The patrol is closed now: you have energy for a foray.
localeEntries./loop/errors/patrol_empty: No fight is waiting right now. Check back in a few minutes.
localeEntries./loop/errors/lead_via_boss: The blood trail starts on the boss card.
localeEntries./luxe/shop/lead: They only change how you look: no stats, no random draws. You get exactly what you see here, and others see it too on your profile, in the arena, in chat and in your showcase.
localeEntries./luxe/where/frame: Around your portrait: HUD, profile, arena.
localeEntries./luxe/where/title: Under your name: profile, arena, chat, rankings.
localeEntries./luxe/where/name: A moving shine on your name: chat, arena, rankings, profile.
localeEntries./luxe/where/backdrop: Behind your hero: Character page, profile, arena.
localeEntries./luxe/where/decor: In your showcase: others see it on your profile. Gives no comfort.
localeEntries./luxe/where/saddle: On your mounts and in your profile showcase.
localeEntries./luxe/where/banner: Above the champion card while you hold the throne, and in the league feed.
localeEntries./luxe/confirm/text: {{coins}} Storm Coins. You buy it once, then wear or remove it any time.
localeEntries./luxe/receipt/bought: You bought {{name}}. You can wear it right away.
localeEntries./luxe/backdrop/lead: Your background shows behind your hero on the Character page, on your profile and in the arena. The default background is free, and you can switch back to it any time.
localeEntries./luxe/backdrop/plainWorn: The default background is behind your hero.
localeEntries./luxe/weekly/desc: Storm Coins, Time-Jump Hourglasses, Stormstone Dust and Ashward Scrolls for the smith, plus Boss Passes and dungeon keys beyond the daily limits. The same contents every week, no random draws. Up to {{perWeek}} per week.
localeEntries./luxe/weekly/line: A whole week of supplies, {{name}}. The same every week, exactly this much.
localeEntries./luxe/weekly/soldOut: All {{perWeek}} bought this week. Available again on Monday.
localeEntries./luxe/weekly/warp_one: {{count}} hour of time jump within the daily limit
localeEntries./luxe/weekly/warp_other: {{count}} hours of time jump within the daily limit
localeEntries./luxe/weekly/oneLeft: You can still buy it this week.
localeEntries./luxe/weekly/oneSoldOut: Bought for this week. Available again on Monday.
localeEntries./luxe/hourglass/useLabel_one: Jump {{count}} hour with an hourglass ({{left}} left)
localeEntries./luxe/hourglass/tip: One hour of time jump without Storm Coins, within the daily limit.
localeEntries./luxe/ticket/have_one: Boss Pass: {{count}}, used after your daily attempts
localeEntries./luxe/ticket/have_other: Boss Passes: {{count}}, used after your daily attempts
localeEntries./luxe/ticket/using_one: Your next attempt uses a Boss Pass ({{count}} left)
localeEntries./luxe/ticket/using_other: Your next attempt uses a Boss Pass ({{count}} left)
localeEntries./luxe/errors/no_hourglass: You do not have enough Time-Jump Hourglasses.
localeEntries./luxe/errors/weekly_limit: You have bought all of them this week. Available again on Monday.
localeEntries./market/lines/sell: Bring what you don't use! Fixed prices, no haggling, just mind the daily limit.
localeEntries./market/lines/reserve: Sold out of what you wanted? I'll reserve it for you. Your nyang rests with me until then, and if the goods don't come, you get it back.
localeEntries./market/lines/bought: Splendid purchase! Nobody has ever brought Triple Seal goods back with a complaint.
localeEntries./market/news/peddlerHere: The Lantern Peddler is on the square for {{time}}
localeEntries./market/deals/hint: Two per level band every four hours, a quarter off.
localeEntries./market/empty/items: The counter is empty right now. Fresh stock arrives every four hours, check back later. Sangbo is polishing the seal in the meantime.
localeEntries./market/empty/filtered: Nobody is selling that right now. Try another filter.
localeEntries./market/empty/stacks: Nobody is selling a stack like that right now.
localeEntries./market/empty/stacksHint: The Storekeeper always stocks forge materials for your current and previous tier, or you can reserve them here.
localeEntries./market/stack/dailyDone: You've used up today's limit for this. You can buy more tomorrow.
localeEntries./market/stack/bought_one: Bought {{count}} {{name}}. It's already in your inventory.
localeEntries./market/stack/bought_other: Bought {{count}} {{name}}. They're already in your inventory.
localeEntries./market/bids/left: The Triple Seal buys materials and shards from you instantly, up to {{nyang}} nyang more today.
localeEntries./market/bids/capped: The Triple Seal won't buy more from you today. Come back tomorrow.
localeEntries./market/bids/empty: You have nothing the Triple Seal wants right now. You gather materials and shards while hunting.
localeEntries./market/bids/sellLabel_one: Sell {{count}} {{name}} to the Triple Seal for {{nyang}} nyang
localeEntries./market/bids/sellLabel_other: Sell {{count}} {{name}} to the Triple Seal for {{nyang}} nyang
localeEntries./market/bids/sold_one: Sold to the Triple Seal: {{count}} {{name}} for {{nyang}} nyang.
localeEntries./market/bids/sold_other: Sold to the Triple Seal: {{count}} {{name}} for {{nyang}} nyang.
localeEntries./market/bids/all: The Triple Seal's full price list
localeEntries./market/merchants/weapon_dealer/greeting: Every blade made for your hand. I forge new ones every six hours.
localeEntries./market/merchants/weapon_dealer/bought: Good choice. Just don't test it on the scabbard!
localeEntries./market/merchants/weapon_dealer/quips/0: One of my swords cut its own sheath yesterday. That sharp.
localeEntries./market/merchants/weapon_dealer/quips/1: Hand on the hilt, nyang on the counter. In that order.
localeEntries./market/merchants/armor_dealer/greeting: Armour, helmets, jewellery, all for your level. A new batch every six hours.
localeEntries./market/merchants/armor_dealer/bought: Now that will hold. If it dents anyway, bring it back.
localeEntries./market/merchants/armor_dealer/quips/0: I tested every piece. This helmet, for one, has met three bears.
localeEntries./market/merchants/armor_dealer/quips/1: Tight? Good. Tight armour doesn't rattle, and rattling armour doesn't protect.
localeEntries./market/merchants/storekeeper/greeting: Materials, shards, scrolls, potions and inventory expansions. Counted twice, all of it.
localeEntries./market/merchants/storekeeper/bought: Handed out, written down, sealed. Next!
localeEntries./market/merchants/storekeeper/quips/0: One, two, three. Again: one, two, three. Checks out.
localeEntries./market/merchants/storekeeper/quips/1: Bag expansion? Wise choice. Junk needs room too.
localeEntries./market/merchants/black_market/greeting: Rare goods, rare prices. My lantern only burns for a few hours, so don't dawdle.
localeEntries./market/merchants/black_market/bought: I won't ask what it's for. Don't ask where it's from.
localeEntries./market/merchants/black_market/quips/0: My lantern doesn't just shine. It watches.
localeEntries./market/merchants/black_market/quips/1: Got this sword from a dragon. Or the dragon got it from me. I forget.
localeEntries./market/merchants/black_market/quips/2: No haggling, no names. You may have some tea, though.
localeEntries./market/merchants/black_market/quips/3: Psst. The Triple Seal knows about me. They just pretend not to.
localeEntries./market/merchant/peddlerAway: The Lantern Peddler isn't in town right now. Twice a day he turns up on the square, lantern in hand.
localeEntries./market/merchant/empty: Nothing to sell right now. Check back later!
localeEntries./market/merchant/noBuysLeft: No purchases left for this visit
localeEntries./market/merchant/rerollHint: You get a whole new selection right now.
localeEntries./market/merchant/bagTip: +{{slots}} slots in your inventory, for good. Each expansion costs more than the last.
localeEntries./market/merchant/extraScroll: Beyond the daily limit, at double price
localeEntries./market/peddler/tip: Rare goods at steep prices: Luck Ore, Stormstone Dust, skill books, eggs, keys and a few truly strong items.
localeEntries./market/reroll/line: Want new bonuses? I'll hammer away, but I only toss the old ones if you say so.
localeEntries./market/reroll/nothing: You have no item to reroll bonuses on.
localeEntries./market/reroll/noBonuses: This one has no bonus, so there's nothing to reroll.
localeEntries./market/reroll/hint: I lay the new bonuses next to the old ones and you choose. You can lock one, and that one stays for sure.
localeEntries./market/reroll/oddsTier: Strength per bonus, weakest to strongest: {{list}}
localeEntries./market/reroll/lockSingle: You can't lock a line on an item with a single bonus line: there would be nothing left to reroll.
localeEntries./market/reroll/noNyang: Not enough nyang for a reroll
localeEntries./market/reroll/chooseLead: Here are the old and the new. Which one stays?
localeEntries./market/reroll/accepted: Done! The new bonuses are on it: {{name}}.
localeEntries./market/reroll/kept: Kept the old ones: {{name}}. The smith keeps the fee.
localeEntries./market/reroll/kindsTitleLine: These can come in place of the picked line ({{count}}):
localeEntries./market/reroll/lockHintNyang: The lock keeps one bonus through the reroll ({{nyang}} nyang).
localeEntries./market/reroll/lockTipNyang: Lock: this bonus surely stays after the reroll. It costs {{nyang}} nyang, paid only when you reroll. Tap again to remove it.
localeEntries./market/reroll/lockHintCoins: Use the lock to keep one bonus through the swap ({{coins}} SC).
localeEntries./market/reroll/lockTipCoins: Lock: this bonus stays for sure after the swap. It costs {{coins}} SC, paid only when you swap. Press it again to unlock.
localeEntries./market/reroll/hintV2: I lay the new bonuses next to the old ones and you choose. Swap as often as you like, there is no daily limit; the price grows with the item's level and +. You can lock one bonus for Storm Coins, and that one stays for sure.
localeEntries./market/errors/offer_gone: Someone got there first. The counter has been refreshed.
localeEntries./market/errors/market_own_hero: One of your heroes sold this to the Triple Seal. You can't buy it back with another hero.
localeEntries./market/errors/offer_not_found: That's no longer on the counter. The list has been refreshed.
localeEntries./market/errors/inventory_full: Your inventory is full. Make some room, then come back.
localeEntries./market/errors/limit_reached: The limit for this is used up. Come back tomorrow (or on the next visit).
localeEntries./market/errors/not_bought: The Triple Seal doesn't buy this.
localeEntries./market/errors/not_in_shop: That's no longer on the counter. The stock has been refreshed.
localeEntries./market/errors/already_bought: You already bought this. The stock has been refreshed.
localeEntries./market/errors/not_rerollable: This stock can't be swapped here.
localeEntries./market/errors/invalid_lock: You can't lock this line. On an item with a single bonus line there would be nothing left to reroll.
localeEntries./market/errors/no_pending_reroll: Nothing to decide on this item. Refreshed.
localeEntries./market/errors/reroll_pending: This item has an unfinished bonus reroll. Decide at the blacksmith first: old bonuses or new ones.
localeEntries./market/errors/request_id_reused: This request got mixed up with an earlier one. Try again.
localeEntries./market/errors/house_item_cap: The Triple Seal won't buy more gear from you today. Come back tomorrow.
localeEntries./market/errors/item_equipped: You're wearing this. Take it off first, then sell it.
localeEntries./market/errors/item_not_found: You no longer have this item. Your inventory has been refreshed.
localeEntries./market/errors/orders_full: You can't have more reservations open right now. The list has been refreshed.
localeEntries./market/errors/not_house_item: The Triple Seal doesn't sell this, so it can't be reserved.
localeEntries./market/errors/not_tradable: The Triple Seal doesn't buy this.
localeEntries./market/errors/order_not_found: That reservation is gone. The list has been refreshed.
localeEntries./market/errors/stale_state: It ran out or changed in the meantime. Refreshed.
localeEntries./market/errors/house_limit: That doesn't fit in today's limit. The card shows how many you can still buy today.
localeEntries./market/errors/item_locked: You locked this item. Unlock it first, then sell it.
localeEntries./market/cityTexts/city/placeHints/weapon: Weapons for your level, new stock every six hours
localeEntries./market/cityTexts/city/placeHints/armor_: Armour, helmets, shields and jewellery, new stock every six hours
localeEntries./market/cityTexts/city/placeHints/storek: Materials, shards, scrolls, potions and inventory expansions
localeEntries./market/cityTexts/npc/storekeeper/line: Materials for the smith, shards, Ashward Scrolls, potions, and if you've outgrown your inventory, an expansion. Two scrolls a day, the rest in moderation too: I count everything twice.
localeEntries./market/cityTexts/npc/weapon_dealer/line: Better? Everything here is better than what you've got, and not just because of the price. I forge a new batch every six hours, all for your class and your level.
localeEntries./market/cityTexts/npc/armor_dealer/line: Breastplates, helmets, shields, boots, even jewellery, all fitted to your level. A new batch leaves the workshop every six hours, and what leaves here lasts.
localeEntries./market/boughtItem: You bought {{name}}. It's already in your bag.
localeEntries./market/sellItem/hint: The Triple Seal pays more for gear than Minah, but only buys a few pieces a day.
localeEntries./market/sellItem/none: You have no gear to sell. Worn and locked items can't be sold.
localeEntries./market/sellItem/loading: Sangbo is sizing up the item…
localeEntries./market/sellItem/left_one: It buys {{count}} more item from you today.
localeEntries./market/sellItem/left_other: It buys {{count}} more items from you today.
localeEntries./market/sellItem/capped: The Triple Seal won't buy more gear from you today. Come back tomorrow, or sell it to Minah meanwhile.
localeEntries./market/sellItem/sellLabel: Sell {{name}} to the Triple Seal for {{nyang}} nyang
localeEntries./market/sellItem/confirm: Sell {{name}} for {{nyang}} nyang? You can't get it back later.
localeEntries./market/sellItem/sold: Sold to the Triple Seal: {{name}} for {{nyang}} nyang.
localeEntries./market/reserve/rules: If something sold out, you can reserve it. We lock the nyang now, and at the next four-hourly restock the Triple Seal fills as much as its stock allows. You can have up to {{max}} reservations, each for {{hours}} hours, and you get back the price of anything not filled.
localeEntries./market/reserve/empty: No reservations yet. If something sold out, ask for it here.
localeEntries./market/reserve/cancelConfirm: Cancel it? The nyang locked for the unfilled part comes back to you.
localeEntries./market/reserve/noItems: The Triple Seal has nothing you could reserve right now.
localeEntries./market/reserve/priceHint: If the Triple Seal fills it for less, you get the difference back.
localeEntries./market/reserve/cap: You already have {{max}} reservations. Wait for one to fill, or cancel one.
localeEntries./market/reserve/placed_one: Reserved: {{count}} {{name}}. Locked: {{nyang}} nyang. It arrives at the next restock if there's stock.
localeEntries./market/reserve/placed_other: Reserved: {{count}} {{name}}. Locked: {{nyang}} nyang. It arrives at the next restock if there's stock.
localeEntries./menu/sources/bestiary: Bestiary: every creature of a region or dungeon defeated at least 10 times
localeEntries./menu/sources/board: Weekly contest: the top three in your level band
localeEntries./menu/achv/hiddenDesc: Hidden achievement. Reach its first tier to find out what it was.
localeEntries./menu/bestiary/intro: Every creature you defeat goes into the codex: hunting, raids, dungeons, the tower and holiday fights all count. Defeat every creature of a region at least 10 times to earn its title.
localeEntries./menu/board/lastAward: You finished #{{rank}} last week, and your reward has already been delivered.
localeEntries./menu/board/forming: The list appears once enough heroes have a result this week.
localeEntries./menu/cup/lead: On Saturday between 18:00 and 20:00 your biggest catch counts. No extra casts needed: your daily catches are enough. The top three anglers of your band get a title and storm bait.
localeEntries./menu/cup/best: Your biggest contest fish this week: {{weight}}
localeEntries./menu/cup/none: No contest fish yet this week.
localeEntries./menu/cup/leadCasts: On Saturday between 18:00 and 20:00 your biggest catch counts. Your first {{max}} manual casts are contest casts and do not use your daily catches. Auto casts do not count in the contest. The top three anglers of your band get a title and storm bait.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/line: Everyone gets the same puzzle from me today, but the hammer falls differently for each of you. Let's see how few strikes you need.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/lead: A daily puzzle: everyone gets the same item and the same aids, but the luck of each try is different for everyone. Reach the target level in as few tries as you can.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/noItems: The trial doesn't give or take any items, nyang or aids. It only earns points for the weekly board.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/protectTip/none: If it fails, the item breaks and today's trial ends.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/protectTip/bless: If it fails, the item drops one level.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/protectTip/safe: If it fails, the item stays where it was.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/status/solved: Done! You earned {{points}} points for the weekly board. A new trial waits tomorrow.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/status/broken: The item broke. A new trial waits tomorrow.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/status/out: You are out of tries for today. A new trial waits tomorrow.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/errors/no_material: You have none of that aid left.
localeEntries./menu/puzzle/errors/stale_attempt: The trial changed in the meantime, so it was refreshed.
localeEntries./mining/locked: Gwangsu lets you down into the mines from level {{level}}.
localeEntries./mining/stock/empty: The cart is still empty. Put your pickaxe to work in a vein.
localeEntries./mining/entry/text: Gwangsu's mines and the Smelter: ore, bars and pickaxes.
localeEntries./mining/mine/lead: Pick a vein and your pickaxe keeps working while you hunt. It swings for up to {{hours}} hours in one go, then you need to collect the ore.
localeEntries./mining/mine/idle: Your pickaxe is resting. Pick a vein and set it to work.
localeEntries./mining/mine/working: Your pickaxe is at work. Vein: {{vein}}.
localeEntries./mining/mine/started: Your pickaxe got to work. Vein: {{vein}}.
localeEntries./mining/mine/factQuartz: {{name}}: {{pct}}% chance per swing, in any vein.
localeEntries./mining/mine/factNight: {{name}}: only turns up at night (between {{from}}:00 and {{to}}:00).
localeEntries./mining/mine/factNightOn: It's night: {{name}} can turn up in your cart now!
localeEntries./mining/smelt/lead: Gwangsu's furnace casts one bar from {{ore}} ore if you pay for the fuel. The price grows with the region and your level.
localeEntries./mining/smelt/noOre: Not enough ore for this bar.
localeEntries./mining/smelt/noNyang: Not enough nyang for the fuel.
localeEntries./mining/craft/pickNext: Next tier ({{tier}}): {{pct}}% faster swings and more Storm Quartz.
localeEntries./mining/craft/pickMax: Even Gwangsu has never seen a better pickaxe.
localeEntries./mining/craft/furnitureLead: Furniture forged from bars. Your Home currently takes quality {{cap}} at most.
localeEntries./mining/craft/noHome: You need a Home before you can have furniture (it's next to the town gate).
localeEntries./mining/craft/furnitureDone: Done: {{name}}. It's already standing in your Home.
localeEntries./mining/craft/furnitureStored: Done: {{name}}. There was no free spot, so it went to the storeroom.
localeEntries./mining/craft/patinaLead: The patina makes your weapon glow, on your paper doll too. It only changes the look.
localeEntries./mining/craft/patinaDone: Done: {{name}}. You can wear it right away.
localeEntries./mining/master/line: “Ore doesn't hurry, kid. But if you never check on it, the cart fills up and the pickaxe sits down for a smoke.”
localeEntries./mining/master/luckLead: {{count}} {{name}} for one Luck Ore. Up to three times a week.
localeEntries./mining/master/luckClaimed: No more trades this week. Again in {{time}}.
localeEntries./mining/master/luckDone: Gwangsu handed over the Luck Ore.
localeEntries./mining/master/noGuild: No guild, no one to give to. Join a guild and your bars can go to its treasury.
localeEntries./mining/master/noBars: You have no bars. Cast a few at the Smelter and take them to your guild ({{guild}}).
localeEntries./mining/master/donateLead: Bars go into your guild's ({{guild}}) treasury, counted at the price you paid when you cast them. The oldest bars go first.
localeEntries./mining/rush/tip: This many hours of ore right now, with the same odds as the pick's own work. The cart keeps filling meanwhile.
localeEntries./mining/rush/capped: Used up for today. Available again at the daily reset ({{time}}).
localeEntries./mining/errors/feature_off: The mines are closed right now.
localeEntries./mining/errors/level_too_low: You need a higher level for this.
localeEntries./mining/errors/vein_locked: You can only mine this vein once you've been to that region.
localeEntries./mining/errors/already_mining: Your pickaxe is already working this vein.
localeEntries./mining/errors/mining_idle: Your pickaxe isn't working. Set it to work in a vein.
localeEntries./mining/errors/mining_empty: Not a single swing is done yet. Check back in a few minutes.
localeEntries./mining/errors/price_changed: The price changed in the meantime. Take another look.
localeEntries./mining/errors/no_home: You need a home for this first.
localeEntries./mining/errors/quality_cap: This quality needs a bigger home.
localeEntries./mining/errors/invalid_hours: That instant yield length isn't available.
localeEntries./mining/errors/no_guild: You need to be in a guild for this.

localeEntries./monet2/refill/tipText: One refill is +{{amount}} energy. The price goes up in steps and starts over every day.
localeEntries./monet2/refill/extra: Refills {{first}} to {{count}} cost more each time ({{from}} to {{to}} SC).
localeEntries./monet2/refill/reset_one: At the daily reset ({{at}}) you get {{count}} refill again, from {{coins}} SC.
localeEntries./monet2/refill/reset_other: At the daily reset ({{at}}) you get {{count}} refills again, from {{coins}} SC.
localeEntries./monet2/energyOut/late: Tomorrow it starts again from {{coins}} SC.
localeEntries./monet2/energyOut/limit_one: No refills left today. At the daily reset ({{at}}) you get {{count}} again.
localeEntries./monet2/energyOut/limit_other: No refills left today. At the daily reset ({{at}}) you get {{count}} again.
localeEntries./monet2/decor/tabHint: Prestige cosmetics one by one or as a set. They give no stats, and you see every piece before buying.
localeEntries./monet2/decor/setsLead: All pieces of a theme together, {{pct}}% off. You don't pay for pieces you already own.
localeEntries./monet2/decor/complete: You own this set, or only one piece is missing: buy that one from the list below.
localeEntries./monet2/decor/confirmText_one: The missing {{count}} piece for {{coins}} Storm Coins. It gives no stats.
localeEntries./monet2/decor/confirmText_other: The missing {{count}} pieces for {{coins}} Storm Coins. They give no stats.
localeEntries./monet2/decor/bought: {{name}}: the pieces are yours, wear them on the Character page.
localeEntries./monet2/packs/xxxl/flavor: The biggest pack at the best rate.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/founder_legend/desc: Legend of the First Storm: title, frame, backdrop, showcase decor, a heap of Storm Coins, a mount, a pass, scrolls, stone dust, luck ore and Dragon Eyes. Only during the opening, once.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/founder_legend/line: The first storm comes only once. The chronicle remembers who was there.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/founder_pack/desc: Stormfounder title and frame, plenty of Storm Coins, a pass, a Striped Egg (your choice), scrolls and stone dust. Only during the opening, once.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/founder_pack/line: No village without founders. Thank you for being here at the start.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/founder_entry/desc: The Stormfounder title, a good pile of Storm Coins, a pass, scrolls and stone dust. Only during the opening, once.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/founder_entry/line: You were here at the start. The chronicle will remember it.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/launch_storm/desc: Storm Coins, scrolls, stone dust, luck ore, boss tickets and a pass in one chest. Only in the launch week, once.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/launch_storm/line: The first week is the stormiest. Have everything you need with you.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/comeback_s/desc: For returning players: the Handful pack with double base Storm Coins.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/comeback_s/line: Long time no see, {{name}}! A little something to get you going.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/comeback_l/desc: For returning players: the Coffer pack with double base Storm Coins.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/comeback_l/line: Long time no see, {{name}}! The treasury is open to old friends too.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/comeback_xl/desc: For returning players: the Treasure Chest pack with double base Storm Coins.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/comeback_xl/line: Long time no see, {{name}}! The treasury is open to old friends too.
localeEntries./monet2/offers/comeback_royal/desc: For returning players: the Royal Chest pack with double base Storm Coins.

localeEntries./offers/kinds/starter/line: Every beginning is hard, but this pack makes it a little easier.

localeEntries./offers/kinds/daily_deal/line: Different every day, and cheaper every day.
localeEntries./offers/kinds/comeback/desc: We missed you! For 48 hours the Purse pack gives double base Storm Coins.
localeEntries./offers/kinds/comeback/line: Long time no see, {{name}}! The village was worried, and the blacksmith was bored.

localeEntries./offers/kinds/arena_band/desc: Available for 7 days after the season closes, once per season.

localeEntries./offers/milestones/first_guild/desc: One purchase only, and only for a short while: your first guild unlocked it.
localeEntries./offers/milestones/first_guild/line: Welcome to the guild, {{name}}! A little nyang and a few scrolls, so you start strong next to the others.
localeEntries./offers/milestones/first_heroic_monkey/d: You can buy it once, for 48 hours: your first heroic clear opened it.
localeEntries./offers/milestones/first_heroic_monkey/l: A heroic clear, {{name}}! Four keys for this dungeon and materials for the Stormheart.
localeEntries./offers/milestones/first_heroic_spider/d: You can buy it once, for 48 hours: your first heroic clear opened it.
localeEntries./offers/milestones/first_heroic_spider/l: A heroic clear, {{name}}! Four keys for this dungeon and materials for the Stormheart.
localeEntries./offers/milestones/first_heroic_dragon/d: You can buy it once, for 48 hours: your first heroic clear opened it.
localeEntries./offers/milestones/first_heroic_dragon/l: A heroic clear, {{name}}! Four keys for this dungeon and materials for the Stormheart.
localeEntries./offers/milestones/home_starter/desc: A one-time offer for a short time only: your first house unlocked it.
localeEntries./offers/milestones/home_starter/line: You have a house of your own now, {{name}}! This pack makes it feel like home right away.
localeEntries./offers/contents/choiceTickets: {{amount}} Boss Passes, you split them between bosses
localeEntries./offers/contents/choiceKeys: {{amount}} dungeon keys, you split them between dungeons
localeEntries./offers/mountSwap: Your current mount ({{name}}, {{time}} left) goes to your stable and waits there. You ride the {{next}} from this pack.
localeEntries./offers/hud/starterTip: One time only per hero, in the hero's first 14 days: 150 Storm Coins, nyang, potions, a scroll and 2 days of Imperial Pass.
localeEntries./offers/gifts/welcome/text: Welcome to the village! Here's a handful of Storm Coins so you can try skipping and rerolling forays for free.
localeEntries./offers/gifts/level_3/text: This is for reaching level 3. An Ashward Scroll, so nothing burns at the blacksmith even on his bad days.
localeEntries./offers/gifts/level_5/text: This is for reaching level 5. Try the Imperial Pass free for one day: more experience and nyang, and the background hunting sack holds more hours of loot.
localeEntries./offers/gifts/level_8/text: This is for reaching level 8. A pony for three days, so you reach the stones sooner. No feeding needed, just praise.
localeEntries./offers/gifts/soul_unlock/text: The Stormheart is open! Here is a Raw Bloodstone: put it into the Fire socket at the alchemist and start refining. Every attempt also needs the stone's essence: Ember Essence drops on Storm Peak floors 56-60 and on M6 runs, and the Triple Seal sells it for nyang too.
localeEntries./offers/gifts/pioneer/text: You joined the kingdom that needed heroes the most. We won't forget it: here's something for the road, and a title that tells everyone.
localeEntries./offers/gifts/founder_set/text: You own all three Stormfounder packs. This frame is only for those who collected all three.
localeEntries./offers/gifts/level_10/text: This is for reaching level 10: a key to the Wildwood Den dungeon. Your first clear brings a companion egg of your choice.
localeEntries./offers/gifts/pet_first_clear/text: For your first Wildwood Den clear: a Speckled Egg, and you choose which companion hatches from it. Hatch it on the Companions tab of the Character page.
localeEntries./offers/events/xp/desc: Every fight and foray gives double experience.
localeEntries./offers/events/package_coins/desc: Storm Coin packs give their base coins twice.
localeEntries./offers/events/forge/desc: Plus 5% chance on every upgrade at the blacksmith.
localeEntries./offers/errors/offer_unavailable: This offer isn't available right now.

localeEntries./offers/named/level_50/line: Level fifty, {{name}}! At the gates of the Dragon Nest a little reserve comes in handy.
localeEntries./offers/named/level_55/line: The Stormheart is open, {{name}}! Soul Dust, Dragon Eyes and blessings for the first steps.
localeEntries./offers/named/level_60/line: Level sixty, you stand at the summit, {{name}}. From here the Stormheart takes you further.
localeEntries./offers/named/arena_top100/desc: You can buy it once this season, for 7 days after the close: you finished between places 11 and 100.
localeEntries./offers/named/arena_top100/line: You finished among the best of the season, {{name}}!
localeEntries./offers/named/arena_top10/desc: You can buy it once this season, for 7 days after the close: you finished in the top ten.
localeEntries./offers/named/arena_top10/line: Top ten, {{name}}! We put this bundle together for champions.
localeEntries./offers/tips/coins: The premium currency: it buys energy, time and forge supplies, and many shop offers are paid with it too.
localeEntries./offers/tips/nyang: The game's money: you upgrade your gear with it at the forge and pay the town merchants with it too.
localeEntries./offers/tips/item: An item that fits your class and this level, already upgraded: equip it right away, with no forging risk.
localeEntries./offers/tips/energy: That many more forays to set out on, and bought energy carries over to the next day.
localeEntries./offers/ladderPopup/line/energy: Your energy has run out. This helps you keep going.
localeEntries./offers/ladderPopup/line/boss: You have no boss attempts left for now. This brings more.
localeEntries./offers/ladderPopup/line/keys: Your dungeon keys are used up. This brings new ones.
localeEntries./offers/ladderPopup/line/forge: The forge was unlucky this time. This protects your next upgrade.
localeEntries./offers/ladderPopup/line/pass: Your Imperial Pass is ending or has just ended. You can renew it here.
localeEntries./offers/ladderPopup/line/value: The best value we can offer you today.
localeEntries./offers/ladderPopup/vip: {{days}} days of Imperial Pass (with daily energy and the extra refill)
localeEntries./offers/ladderPopup/treasure: Portal pieces and a dungeon key, once a day.
localeEntries./offers/ladderPopup/energyChest: Everyone in your guild gets {{energy}} energy.

localeEntries./pets/intro: One companion can be active at a time: only it gives a bonus, and only it walks beside you.
localeEntries./pets/empty: No companions yet. A companion hatches from an egg and, while it's with you, gives a bonus: more XP, nyang or loot, or more power in combat.
localeEntries./pets/sources/wheel: One free spin a day, and the Companion egg is among the prizes.
localeEntries./pets/sources/hunt: Map bosses can leave an egg the first time you beat them, monsters at the hunting spots now and then. Why? Hakmun is still researching that.
localeEntries./pets/sources/huntV3: Map bosses can leave an egg on the first kill; hunting-spot monsters only very rarely.
localeEntries./pets/sources/events: During holidays, the Holiday shop sells eggs for tokens.
localeEntries./pets/sources/dungeon: Dungeons: the main source of eggs and bond thread.
localeEntries./pets/sources/dungeonV3: Dungeons: the home of eggs, evolution cores, skill books and bond thread.

localeEntries./pets/skills/potion_boost/desc: Potions restore a further {{value}}% of your health.

localeEntries./premium/intro: Storm Coins are the impatient hero's friend: they buy energy, time and a pinch of luck, and in the endgame faster Stormheart progress, which makes you stronger too. Energy, time, forge items and Stormheart materials can also be earned by playing, just more slowly; many looks, though, are only available here, such as the founder looks and the Prestige cosmetics.

localeEntries./rankings/guildOrderHint: The building level is the sum of the levels of the guild's five buildings: Headquarters, Forge, Dojo, Warehouse and War banner. Members' donations fill the treasury, and an officer or the leader spends it on upgrades, which take time and can be sped up with Storm Coins. localeEntries./research/steps/wolf/story: A wolf fang! Look, look: tiny blue veins run through the enamel, just like the cracks in the stormstones. These wolves didn't simply go wild, they gnawed on the stones, and the stone soaked right into their teeth! Bring me ten good samples and I'll find out how to turn that power to your advantage.
localeEntries./research/steps/boar/story: A boar tusk! Boars root around exactly where the stones crashed down, and the dust builds up in their bones. Imagine, the storm dust doesn't poison them, it makes them tougher! Once I crack the ratio, you'll take a hit or two more as well.
localeEntries./research/steps/bear/story: A bear claw, at last! Cut across, it shows layers like tree rings, and every layer remembers a storm. Bears don't get stronger from the stones, they grow thicker armour against them after every storm, and we simply have to steal that trick!
localeEntries./research/steps/tiger/story: Tiger fur! Did you know its stripes fork exactly like lightning? Every tiger carries a little storm in its coat, and when it pounces, the stone's spark guides its paw. That's how they always know where the weak spot is!
localeEntries./research/steps/archer/story: An arrowhead from a highwayman's quiver, and it isn't iron, it's a polished stormstone shard! The shard remembers the storm it came from and pulls toward it in flight. Once we understand which way it pulls, you'll always dodge a step ahead.
localeEntries./research/steps/mercenary/story: A mercenary badge, and look, there's a stormstone chip set right into its centre! Someone is collecting the stones on purpose, and the mercenaries work for them. That's not biology anymore, that's a conspiracy, but the chip is still just as thrilling!
localeEntries./research/steps/orc/story: An orc amulet carved from a tusk, and the marks on it are older than the empire! The orcs knew the stones back when all we ever had was rain. It seems the storms didn't come for the first time, we just forgot them.
localeEntries./research/steps/shaman/story: The shaman's bone with the spiral, and now I understand: it isn't decoration, it's a map! Every storm turns around a single point, and the stones are pieces of the same heart. If we find that heart, maybe we can put an end to the storms!
localeEntries./research/steps/scorpion/story: A scorpion sting! Look at the tip: the venom has crystallised, and the same blue veins run through it as through the wolves' fangs. In the desert the stones didn't crash down, they sank under the sand, and the scorpions nested right on top of them. Bring me ten samples and I'll find out how you can strike exactly where it counts.
localeEntries./research/steps/mummy/story: A strip of bandage from a ruin warden, and it isn't linen, it's silk soaked in stone dust! Someone wrapped those guards up like this long ago so the storm couldn't harm them, and they're still standing. Once I crack the weave, you'll take a hit or two more as well. Sadly there's no recipe against the smell.
localeEntries./research/steps/snow_wolf/story: Snowmane fur, and the ice in it didn't freeze by accident: it forms tiny spirals, just like the shaman's bone. Up on the pass the heart of the storm is closer, the wolves can feel it, and they grow thicker coats against it. We're borrowing that coat. For science, naturally.
localeEntries./research/steps/yeti/story: Shaggy yeti fur! Did you know a yeti isn't shaggy from the cold, but from the lightning? A spark sleeps in every hair, and when the yeti pounces, it guides the paw straight to the weak spot. Just one more sample, and then really just one more.
localeEntries./research/steps/fire_imp/story: A fire imp horn, still warm! Imps carry the stones' embers in their pockets, and that makes them so quick they leave their own shadows behind. Once I work out how they do it, you'll dodge before the blow even lands.
localeEntries./research/steps/magma_giant/title: The Heart of the Storm Beats
localeEntries./research/steps/magma_giant/story: A magma giant's heart, and look, it's beating! Slowly, like a great drum under the ground. It's a piece of the very heart every storm turns around: the stones came from here, and they're pulling back here. Once I understand its beat, every swing of yours will beat along with it.
localeEntries./research/lines/ready: Got a sample? Hand it over, my hands are shaking with excitement!
localeEntries./research/lines/waiting: I'm still examining the last samples. A little patience, science doesn't rush.
localeEntries./research/lines/noSample: No sample yet? Don't lose heart, hunting is research too, just louder.
localeEntries./research/lines/locked: Forgive me, you're still a bit green for this research. Come back at level {{level}}!
localeEntries./research/lines/allDone: We've finished every study! Now I'm writing the book. You'll be in it, chapter three.
localeEntries./research/lines/success/0: A perfect sample! It goes straight under the magnifier.
localeEntries./research/lines/success/1: Yes, yes, YES! Exactly what I needed.
localeEntries./research/lines/success/2: Look at these veins! Beautiful. Scientifically speaking.
localeEntries./research/lines/success/3: Exactly what I was missing! Well, this and one more. But this is very good.
localeEntries./research/lines/success/4: It holds up! I'll mention it in a footnote. Twice.
localeEntries./research/lines/fail/0: Oh, this one crumbled to dust before I could write it down.
localeEntries./research/lines/fail/1: Hm. That's more mud than sample. Chin up, science fails a lot too.
localeEntries./research/lines/fail/2: Contaminated. Failure is data too, just less entertaining.
localeEntries./research/lines/fail/3: Sadly, this isn't a sample. It's a very convincing pebble.
localeEntries./research/lines/fail/4: Didn't work. Bring another. And one more after that, just to be safe.
localeEntries./research/lines/complete: Got it! The tenth sample is in place, the discovery is complete. Look at this!
localeEntries./research/lines/skip: Fine, fine, I'll look faster. I've polished the magnifier anyway.
localeEntries./research/lines/elixir: With a drop of this, the next samples will almost certainly work!

localeEntries./research/sample/rule: A sample drops only from a won active fight (foray, stone guardians, boss, dungeon, tower), never from AFK hunting. It is collected only for the active step. A sample is a separate item: a material with a similar name doesn't count.
localeEntries./research/sample/ruleHelp: Only fights you win yourself can drop a sample (foray, stone guardians, boss, dungeon, tower), at the chances shown above. AFK hunting never drops one. Samples are collected only for the active step: a fight won before it starts brings none.

localeEntries./research/skip/hint: The examination finishes at once, and you can deliver again.
localeEntries./research/elixir/hint: +30% success chance for every sample of the next delivery.
localeEntries./research/elixir/active: The elixir works on every sample of the next delivery.
localeEntries./research/lockedNote: Research starts at level {{level}}. Until then, grow stronger at the hunting grounds!

localeEntries./retention/wind/help/untilLevel: It blows until you reach level {{level}}. The recommended level rises every day, so this limit moves up too.
localeEntries./retention/wind/help/untilGeneric: It blows until you get close to the recommended level.
localeEntries./retention/wind/help/basis: It follows the world’s calendar, that is, the days since opening (24-hour days), not anyone else’s level: on day {{day}} of the world the recommended level is {{level}}, and you are level {{mine}}.
localeEntries./retention/wind/help/others: Someone already at level 50 gives you nothing extra: only your gap to today’s recommended level counts.
localeEntries./retention/wind/help/whyOpening: The world just opened: for the first two days every hero from level {{min}} gets it, until level {{level}}.
localeEntries./retention/momentum/line: Momentum: +{{pct}}% damage against the region lord on your next attempt.
localeEntries./retention/momentum/tip/forge: Tip: forge your weapon to at least +4, it helps more than any luck.
localeEntries./retention/momentum/tip/level: Tip: the region lord is tuned for level {{level}}. One or two more levels make it much easier.
localeEntries./retention/momentum/tip/potion: Tip: bring potions, and check your stats on the Character page.
localeEntries./retention/winback/label: Comeback email if you are away for a while
localeEntries./retention/winback/hint: If you don't play for 7, 14 or 30 days (on day 2 too if the daily summary is on), we email you and tell you which free gift is waiting. At most one email a week, none after day 30. This is a separate consent you can withdraw any time.
localeEntries./retention/winback/unsub/text: Unsubscribe with one click and we won't send any more comeback emails.
localeEntries./retention/winback/unsub/done: You are unsubscribed. We won't send any more comeback emails.
localeEntries./retention/winback/unsub/invalid: This unsubscribe link is not valid. You can also turn it off on the Account page.
localeEntries./retention/homecoming/lead: Every stone you break on forays or in Stone Rain during Homecoming Week counts for the whole world. Together we need {{target}} stones; every tier rewards everyone.
localeEntries./retention/tasks/carried: Left over from an earlier day: you can still claim it today. It does not count towards the daily chest.
localeEntries./retention/guildWeek/lead: Your guild members' forays, stones, dungeons, raids, leads, portals and Rune Row games count towards the weekly shared goal. Not a daily chore: add to it any time during the week.
localeEntries./retention/guildWeek/totalNote: The guild total weighs each member's points: in full for members with a confirmed email, level 20 or higher and 3 days in the guild; at half for level 10-19 or 1-3 days in the guild; otherwise not at all. So the total can be lower than the members' own points added up.
localeEntries./retention/guildWeek/share: To claim, you need to contribute at least {{pct}}% of this week's points.
localeEntries./retention/guildWeek/raidNights: Guild raid nights: {{days}}, from {{start}}; raids give +{{pct}}% guild points then.
localeEntries./retention/guildWeek/raidNow: It's guild raid night: raids give +{{pct}}% guild points.
localeEntries./retention/guildWeek/notCounted: Your points still count toward your own reward. They count toward the guild's shared goal once you have a confirmed email address, are level 20 or higher, and have been in the guild for at least 3 days.
localeEntries./retention/pushPrompt/text: Want a ping when your energy is full or you can climb the Tower again?
localeEntries./retention/pushPrompt/runText: You're off on a long foray. Want us to tell you when it's done?
localeEntries./retention/discordPrompt/text: Come to our Discord! Claim a reward every day in the #daily-rewards channel, and there is a giveaway almost every week. Join the server and link your Discord to the game: it only counts that way.
localeEntries./retention/discordPrompt/reward: Linking also gives you {{amount}} Nyang and the Stormcaller title.
localeEntries./retention/ratingPrompt/question: How much do you enjoy Stonestorm?
localeEntries./retention/ratingPrompt/happy: Thank you! Would you rate us on Google Play too?
localeEntries./retention/ratingPrompt/sad: Sorry to hear that! What's bothering you? Tell us
localeEntries./retention/day0/lead: Your first day is done. Here is what waits for you tomorrow:
localeEntries./retention/day0/chest: Your Travel Chest opens tomorrow at {{time}} and waits for you all day.
localeEntries./retention/day0/saveLead: Save your hero so it waits for you on any device.
localeEntries./rift/intro: The storm cracked the mountain right under the village. Every day the Rift shows a new map, the same one for everyone: here your choices count, not your luck.
localeEntries./rift/locked: The Storm Rift opens at level {{level}}.
localeEntries./rift/entry: 15 floors, one shared map a day, card by card. Seals buy energy, a boss attempt and a dungeon key on the shelf.
localeEntries./rift/entryShort: A daily 15-floor challenge for free energy, boss attempts and dungeon keys.
localeEntries./rift/head/capFull: You reached the {{cap}} seal cap: spend on the shelf to earn again.
localeEntries./rift/rank/rule: Filled by the XP you earn after level 60. Rewards: looks and Rift Seals.
localeEntries./rift/start/desc: 1-3 seals a floor, a chest adds three more, plus a little XP and nyang.
localeEntries./rift/start/done: No runs left today. {{n}} new ones open tomorrow.
localeEntries./rift/start/doneBonus: Today's {{base}} runs are used up. Ropes still needed to open run {{run}}: {{n}}.
localeEntries./rift/ropes/lead: Each rope cuts the wait between runs by {{cut}} min, and {{at}} ropes open run {{n}}.
localeEntries./rift/ropes/wait: Wait between runs: {{min}} min ({{full}} with {{max}} ropes)
localeEntries./rift/ropes/bonusUsed: All {{n}} of today's runs are used.
localeEntries./rift/ropes/none: No ropes yet today. Ask your friends to send you some!
localeEntries./rift/ropes/sentAllMore: Ropes sent: {{n}}. More friends are left, tap again.
localeEntries./rift/ropes/sentAllNone: There is no one to send a rope to right now.
localeEntries./rift/ropes/shareText: Let's be friends in Stonestorm and send each other ropes for the Storm Rift:
localeEntries./rift/ropeIntro/cut: Each rope cuts the wait between runs by {{min}} minutes.
localeEntries./rift/ropeIntro/send: You can send each of your friends one rope a day, too.
localeEntries./rift/rules: In the fights everything your hero has counts: gear, Stormheart, elixirs and every stat point. The healing potion works in every fight, and your hero keeps their HP from floor to floor.
localeEntries./rift/last/fallen: Your strength ran out on floor {{floor}}.
localeEntries./rift/run/retryWait: Try again in {{time}}, at full HP.
localeEntries./rift/run/pick: Choose your opponent. The floor's bonus is yours after the win.
localeEntries./rift/cards/rest/desc: Heal a little after the win.
localeEntries./rift/cards/treasure/desc: Extra seals and points after the win.
localeEntries./rift/blessings/might/desc: +10% damage for the rest of the run
localeEntries./rift/blessings/ward/desc: +15% defence for the rest of the run
localeEntries./rift/notes/treasureRanked: The chest is empty, but the points are yours.
localeEntries./rift/result/lost: You fell on floor {{floor}}. The run goes on: try again after the wait.
localeEntries./rift/shelf/lead: Buy from the shelf with Rift Seals.
localeEntries./rift/shelf/rule: Daily items have a daily cap, helper items a weekly one. The boss attempt and the key are for that day only.
localeEntries./rift/shelf/homeTier: Can be placed from home level {{tier}}
localeEntries./rift/shelf/need/energy_full: Your energy is full: buy it once at least {{qty}} is missing from your daily energy. Free energy, use it the same day.
localeEntries./rift/shelf/need/boss_free_left: Buy it once you have used at least one of today's free boss attempts. It counts as a free attempt and expires at midnight.
localeEntries./rift/shelf/need/keys_free_left: Buy it once you have used at least one of today's free dungeon keys. It counts as a free key, works for any dungeon and expires at midnight.
localeEntries./rift/path/label: The Rift path: you are on floor {{floor}} of {{floors}}
localeEntries./rift/today/rift/where: The Storm Rift card on the Dungeons tab of the Hunt page.
localeEntries./rift/today/rift/done: Today's runs are used up; new ones open tomorrow.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_locked: The Rift is still closed to you.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_active: You are already in the Rift.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_no_runs: No runs left today. New ones open tomorrow.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_wait: The next run isn't open yet. Come back a little later.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_floor_wait: The next floor isn't open yet. Catch your breath, you can go on soon.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_off: The Rift is closed right now.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_shelf_cap: You can't buy more of this this week.
localeEntries./rift/errors/card_not_found: This card can't be picked anymore.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_shelf_unknown: This item is no longer on the shelf.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_fight_first: Win this floor's fight first. The bonus comes after it.

localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_rope_sent_today: You already sent this friend a rope today. You can send another tomorrow.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_rope_sent_account: Another hero of your account already sent this friend a rope today. You can send another tomorrow.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_rope_full: Your friend already has all of today's ropes.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_rope_too_new: You can only send ropes to friends of at least {{hours}} h.
localeEntries./rift/errors/rift_shelf_daily_cap: You can't buy more of this today. It's back on the shelf tomorrow.
localeEntries./rift/share/text: Storm Rift: all floors cleared ({{floors}}/{{floors}})! Score: {{score}}. Play Stonestorm with me:
localeEntries./rift/share/copied: Link copied. Paste it wherever you like.
localeEntries./rift/share/downloaded: Picture saved. Post it with your link!
localeEntries./runasor/intro: Lay down three cards at a time: a run of numbers in one colour, or the same number in all three colours. The more points you collect, the better the chest you open.
localeEntries./runasor/decks/full: That's all your games for today. Come back tomorrow.
localeEntries./runasor/decks/empty: You're out of decks. Join a Stone Rain or land your 10th fish of the day for another one, or wait for midnight.
localeEntries./runasor/decks/free: Daily decks are free. Above the daily limit, you can get one more for Storm Coins.
localeEntries./runasor/start/dailyHint: A fresh shuffle, just for you.
localeEntries./runasor/start/weeklyHint: You can play it once a week. Your score goes on the weekly ranking.
localeEntries./runasor/start/weeklyDone: You've played this week's challenge: {{score}} points.
localeEntries./runasor/rules/hand: You hold 5 cards. The other 19 wait face down in the deck.
localeEntries./runasor/rules/move: Lay down 3 cards if they make a combo. If you have nothing good, discard one and draw a new card.
localeEntries./runasor/rules/end: The game ends when the deck runs out and you can't lay down another set of three.
localeEntries./runasor/combo/runRule: one colour, numbers in a row
localeEntries./runasor/combo/setRule: the same number in all three colours
localeEntries./runasor/combo/mixedRule: numbers in a row, mixed colours
localeEntries./runasor/combo/none: These three cards don't make a combo.
localeEntries./runasor/combo/pick: Select 3 cards to lay down, or 1 to discard.
localeEntries./runasor/actions/finishText: You'll get the chest for your current {{score}} points: {{chest}}.
localeEntries./runasor/actions/keys: Keys: 1-5 select, Enter lays down, D discards, F finishes
localeEntries./runasor/actions/mouse: Mouse: left click selects, right click takes back or discards
localeEntries./runasor/table/expires: If you leave it, the game closes after 24 hours with the points you have.
localeEntries./runasor/chest/live: Nothing is left to chance, but the contents depend on your hero's level, region and the weekly Bonus Reroller limit, so they can change. Your chest is worked out when the game ends.
localeEntries./runasor/chest/luckCapped: You've already had this week's Bonus Rerollers from the Rune Row, so you get shards instead.
localeEntries./runasor/board/lead: This week's challenge results in your world.
localeEntries./runasor/board/gathering: Results are coming in. The list appears once {{top}} heroes have played.
localeEntries./runasor/board/cutoff: Score needed for place {{top}} right now: {{score}}
localeEntries./runasor/board/kingdomsHint: Each kingdom shows its players' average, so headcount doesn't matter.
localeEntries./runasor/shards/lead: You'll find shards in Gold and Star chests. Trade them for card backs and a title.
localeEntries./runasor/shards/title_text: Shown next to your name on your profile and in rankings.
localeEntries./runasor/errors/no_deck: You're out of decks. A new one arrives at midnight.
localeEntries./runasor/errors/daily_limit: You've played your 3 games for today.
localeEntries./runasor/errors/game_open: You already have an unfinished game.
localeEntries./runasor/errors/weekly_done: You've already played this week's challenge.

localeEntries./runasor/errors/invalid_combo: These three cards don't make a combo.
localeEntries./runasor/errors/deck_empty: The deck is empty, so you can't discard any more.
localeEntries./runasor/errors/feature_off: Rune Row isn't available right now.
localeEntries./runasor/errors/deck_available: You still have a game left today. Play that one first.

localeEntries./runasor/lanterns/done: You found them all today. New ones hide tomorrow.
localeEntries./runasor/lanterns/tokens: The chest gives {{count}} Wisp Lanterns, above the daily limit

localeEntries./runasor/extra/label: One more deck today for {{coins}} Storm Coins
localeEntries./runasor/extra/tip: One more game today, above the daily limit. Each further deck costs twice the one before, and the price resets at midnight.
localeEntries./shopdaily/line: These are only here until the daily rollover ({{at}}), and most have a little extra. Then a fresh batch comes.
localeEntries./shopdaily/refreshing: Fresh deals are on their way…
localeEntries./shopdaily/rerollHint: You get six new items in place of these, for today.
localeEntries./shopdaily/empty: You bought everything for today. New deals come at the daily rollover ({{at}}), or reroll for more.
localeEntries./shopdaily/forge/safeHint: If it fails, the item neither burns nor drops a level. Can't be used with an Ashward Scroll.
localeEntries./shopdaily/forge/safeCapped: Used up for today ({{used}}/{{max}}), resets at {{at}}.

localeEntries./shopdaily/forge/failNoBurn/1: No luck, but nothing burns at this level yet. Try again!

localeEntries./shopdaily/bag/max: Your bag has reached its largest size ({{size}} slots).
localeEntries./shopdaily/bag/maxCoins: No more expansions for Storm Coins. Jamul the storekeeper can still enlarge your bag for nyang.
localeEntries./shopdaily/bag/effect: +{{slots}} bag slots, for good. At most {{max}} expansions.
localeEntries./shopdaily/errors/already_bought: You already bought this. We refreshed the deals.
localeEntries./shopdaily/errors/limit_reached: You can't buy more of this.
localeEntries./shopdaily/errors/unknown_premium_item: This item is no longer available.
localeEntries./shopdaily/errors/safe_cap: Today's Stormstone Dust limit is used up.
localeEntries./skills/path/intro: From level 5 you can pick one of two paths. A path gives you a new combat skill and a permanent bonus.
localeEntries./skills/path/locked_one: {{count}} more level and you can choose.
localeEntries./skills/path/locked_other: {{count}} more levels and you can choose.
localeEntries./skills/path/confirmText: On this path {{skill}} becomes your skill. You can reset it later for {{coins}} SC, but the skill level is lost.
localeEntries./skills/path/chosen: You walk the way of the {{name}}. Good luck!
localeEntries./skills/path/traits/guard_one: the next hit only half hurts
localeEntries./skills/path/traits/guard_other: the next {{count}} hits only half hurt
localeEntries./skills/path/confirmTextFree: This path gives you the skill {{skill}}. You can re-pick once for free until level 10.

localeEntries./skills/book/none: No books. You find them on forays, from bosses and in the tower, or you can buy one.
localeEntries./skills/book/chanceNote: Every read uses up a book, then you rest for {{hours}} hours. On success the skill gains a level.
localeEntries./skills/book/patienceLabel: Patience scroll: the wait ends right away ({{cost}})

localeEntries./skills/book/fail: The book was too murky, no luck this time. Try again in {{hours}} hours.
localeEntries./skills/book/patienceDone: The wait is over, you can read.
localeEntries./skills/book/bought: You are one skill book richer.
localeEntries./skills/book/needPath: The book improves your path's skill. Choose a path on the Skills tab first.
localeEntries./skills/book/buyNyangLabel: Buy a skill book for {{nyang}} nyang
localeEntries./skills/book/capWait: Your skill is at your level's cap. The next book can be read from level {{level}}.
localeEntries./skills/reset/text: The way of the {{name}} ends, the skill level drops back to 1, and you can choose again. It costs {{coins}} SC.
localeEntries./skills/reset/done: Path reset. Pick a new one!
localeEntries./skills/reset/free: Your first re-pick is free until level 10.
localeEntries./skills/reset/textFree: The way of the {{name}} ends, the skill level drops back to 1, and you can choose again. This time it is free.
localeEntries./skills/bonus/intro: What boosts you right now, by source, except your gear. Sources add up, up to the cap; boosts bought for Storm Coins (Imperial Pass, brews) come on top of it, brews bought for nyang count within it.
localeEntries./skills/bonus/gearNote: Your gear bonuses (XP, nyang, stats) are on the Stats tab.
localeEntries./skills/bonus/paidOutside: bought {{value}}, on top of the cap (up to {{max}})
localeEntries./skills/bonus/nothing: Nothing boosts you right now. The Imperial Pass, elixirs, mounts and research all add up.
localeEntries./skills/bonus/tipMore: Click for details: every bonus by source.
localeEntries./skills/bonus/vip/hint: For 7 days: +25% XP, +20% nyang, +10% loot and more.
localeEntries./skills/bonus/elixir/hint: Sold by the alchemist, they last a day.
localeEntries./skills/bonus/mount/hint: Rent one at the stable and every journey gets shorter.
localeEntries./skills/bonus/research/hint: The monster scholar's finished research boosts you for good.
localeEntries./skills/bonus/path/hint: The path you pick from level 5 gives a permanent bonus.
localeEntries./skills/bonus/event/hint: No event is running. When one is, its multiplier shows up here.

localeEntries./skills/errors/level_required: You can choose a path from level 5.

localeEntries./skills/errors/cooldown: Your eyes still need rest: wait, or use a patience scroll.
localeEntries./skills/errors/no_cooldown: There's nothing to wait for, you can read.

localeEntries./skills/paths/warrior_a/tagline: One sword, one direction: round and round.
localeEntries./skills/paths/warrior_a/desc: Knights used to charge at windmills. These days the windmill charges at everyone, with a greatsword where the sails should be. Never dizzy, never tired, and always puzzled why everyone flees once the warm-up starts.
localeEntries./skills/paths/warrior_b/tagline: Shield first, pain can wait its turn.
localeEntries./skills/paths/warrior_b/desc: Running into a Stonewall is like headbutting a mountain: the mountain doesn't even notice. Stonewalls charge in shield first and only half notice the next two hits. Healers adore them, because they almost never need healing.
localeEntries./skills/paths/ninja_a/tagline: Small, fast, and always stings twice.
localeEntries./skills/paths/ninja_a/desc: Wasps aren't big, but a single one can empty a whole camp. They work with twin daggers and treat armour as more of a suggestion. If you hear the buzzing, it's too late, and if you don't, it's even later.
localeEntries./skills/paths/ninja_b/tagline: Shoots from afar. Up close, nobody's left.
localeEntries./skills/paths/ninja_b/desc: Rainmakers never come close, and why would they? One pull of the bowstring sends up a whole cloud of arrows, and the forecast is in: overcast, with a hundred percent chance of arrows. They dodge well too, because what never reaches you can't hurt.
localeEntries./skills/paths/mage_a/tagline: Every strike a bite, every bite a life.
localeEntries./skills/paths/mage_a/desc: The demon in the blade is always hungry, and a Glutton never says no to it. Every strike nips a mouthful off the enemy's life and patches the Glutton up with it. Every innkeeper in the region has banned Gluttons, and all they ever asked for was soup.
localeEntries./skills/paths/mage_b/tagline: The one monsters fear in the dark.
localeEntries./skills/paths/mage_b/desc: Village mothers threaten their children with the Bogeyman, and the children pass the threat on to the monsters. Bogeyman magic doesn't knock on armour, it goes straight through to the soul, where all that's left is a cold sweat. Best avoided after dark, and approached with care in daylight.
localeEntries./skills/paths/shaman_a/tagline: One flick of the fan, then thunder.
localeEntries./skills/paths/shaman_a/desc: A Thunderfan settles any argument with one flick of the wrist, usually by settling the other party. Then comes a polite bow, because manners matter, especially over a pile of ash. Nobody argues with a Thunderfan on a rainy day, and on sunny days only those who forgot to look up.
localeEntries./skills/paths/shaman_b/tagline: Heals, protects, and only sometimes calls lightning.
localeEntries./skills/paths/shaman_b/desc: A Cloud Shepherd herds clouds the way others herd sheep, and any cloud that strays comes back with lightning. Every strike is a heavenly poultice: it stings the enemy and soothes the shepherd. They get more out of potions than anyone, too, because they know which end to drink from.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/intro: Every currency and point in one place: how much you have, where it comes from, what it's for.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/nyang/from: Almost everything: hunting, forays, selling, tasks, fights.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/nyang/for: Forging, stat points, merchants, mounts. Gangdo can already hear it jingling.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/coins/from: Daily logins, achievements, events and purchases.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/coins/for: Energy, skips, Imperial Pass and the shop's convenience items.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/season/from: Daily tasks, forays and fights, up to a daily cap.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/season/for: Storm Road tiers and rewards until the season ends.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/honor/for: The leaderboard and the arena season reward.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/lantern/for: The holiday shop. You can still spend them for a few days after the holiday.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/shard/from: Forays, bosses, the weekly boss and the Storekeeper.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/shard/for: Forging from +7 to +9, and refining Stormheart stones.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/safe_stone/for: At the forge: on a failure the item doesn't burn or drop a level.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/soul_dust/from: From level 55: forays, hunting from region 5, the heroic dungeon, the Storm Peak and the weekly boss, plus dismantling Stormheart stones and the alchemist contract.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/essence/from: From level 55: forays in regions 5 and 6, hunting in region 5, the heroic dungeon, the Storm Peak, the weekly boss, Nakshi's fishing trades and the arena. The Triple Seal also sells it for nyang.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/essence/for: Upgrading Stormheart stones, each kind for its own stone.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/soul_eye_shard/from: The weekly boss, the heroic dungeon, the top floor of the Storm Peak and legendary fish, and the Triple Seal sells them for nyang.
localeEntries./skills/wallet/rows/soul_eye_shard/for: Ten of them make a Dragon Eye: needed for your stones' grade-change steps, later for the Celestial stars too.
localeEntries./skills/paidCaps/readCapped: Enough reading for today: at most {{max}} books a day. Continue after midnight (Budapest time).
localeEntries./skills/paidCaps/rule: Up to {{max}} reads and {{buy}} bought books a day.
localeEntries./skills/paidCaps/buyCapped: No more books to buy today: at most {{max}} a day. You can buy again after midnight (Budapest time).
