localeEntries./social/pokes/empty: Nobody has greeted you yet. Even the carrier pigeon is napping.
localeEntries./social/pokes/pick: What do you want to tell {{name}}?
localeEntries./social/pokes/wait: You greeted them a moment ago. Try again in a few minutes.
localeEntries./social/pokes/greetings/rainMeet: See you at the Stone Rain!
localeEntries./social/prefs/feed: My deeds may appear in the city news
localeEntries./social/prefs/online: Others can see when I'm playing
localeEntries./social/prefs/arenaMail: Notify me when I'm attacked in the arena
localeEntries./social/prefs/arenaBadge: Show the red badge on the Arena button when I'm attacked
localeEntries./social/prefs/note: For 7 days, players in your world can see your level-ups, forging, boss wins and tower results in the city news. You can turn this off at any time.
localeEntries./social/feed/level: {{name}} just reached level {{level}}! Dongsu is already tuning the drum.
localeEntries./social/feed/forge: A new gleam in the hands of {{name}}: {{item}} +{{plus}}! Gangdo only said: "Hm."
localeEntries./social/feed/fox: {{name}} defeated Hwaryeon, the Nine-Tailed! Eight of her nine tails are still sulking.
localeEntries./social/feed/world_boss: {{boss}} has fallen! {{name}} landed the final blow. Captain Mugang almost smiled.
localeEntries./social/feed/tower: {{name}} climbed to floor {{floor}} of the tower. The Landlord is already counting the rent.
localeEntries./social/block/confirm: Block {{name}}? You won't see their messages anymore, and they can't send you friend requests or challenge you. Your friendship ends too. They won't be notified.
localeEntries./social/block/done: You blocked {{name}}. You won't see their messages anymore.
localeEntries./social/block/blocked: You blocked this hero. You don't see their messages, and they can't send you friend requests.
localeEntries./social/block/limit: You've reached the block limit. Unblock someone in your account settings first.
localeEntries./social/block/failed: That didn't work. Please try again!
localeEntries./social/block/ingame: Faster help in the game: ⚙️ Settings → Help.
localeEntries./social/block/support: Trouble with a player? Write to us:
localeEntries./social/blocked/intro: When you block someone, you don't see their messages or news, and they can't send you friend requests or challenge you in the arena. They aren't notified. You can block a hero on their profile or in the menu of a chat message.
localeEntries./social/errors/friend_limit: Not possible right now: a friend list is full, or too many requests are waiting.
localeEntries./social/errors/requests_closed: This hero isn't accepting friend requests right now.
localeEntries./social/errors/player_not_found: There's no hero with that name in your world. Check the spelling.
localeEntries./social/errors/friend_exists: You're already friends, or the request is on its way.
localeEntries./social/errors/friend_self: You can't send a request to yourself. You two get along fine anyway.
localeEntries./social/errors/friend_own_hero: Your own heroes can't be friends with each other.
localeEntries./social/errors/friend_link_other_world: This friend link is from a hero in another world. You can only make friends within your own world.
localeEntries./social/errors/friend_link_unavailable: This friend link can't be used right now.
localeEntries./social/errors/request_limit: You've sent all your requests for today. You can send more tomorrow.
localeEntries./social/errors/poke_cooldown: You greeted them a moment ago. Wait a few minutes.
localeEntries./social/errors/poke_limit: You're out of greetings for today. Carry on tomorrow.
localeEntries./social/errors/friend_not_found: This hero is no longer on your friend list.
localeEntries./social/errors/request_not_found: This request is no longer active.
localeEntries./social/errors/player_blocked: You blocked this hero. To send a friend request, unblock them first.
localeEntries./social/errors/generic: Something went wrong. Please try again a bit later.
localeEntries./social/errors/gift_too_new: You can send gifts after one day of friendship.
localeEntries./social/errors/gift_sent_today: You already sent them a gift today. Try again tomorrow.
localeEntries./social/errors/gift_friend_deleting: This hero is being deleted and can't get gifts. Nothing was sent, your daily gifts are untouched.
localeEntries./social/errors/recall_limit: You've already called back {{max}} friends today. You can call more tomorrow.
localeEntries./social/errors/recall_not_away: {{name}} has played in the last few days, no need to call them back now.
localeEntries./social/dm/friendsOnly: You can only message your friends.
localeEntries./social/dm/placeholder: What do you want to say?
localeEntries./social/dm/tooLong: A message fits at most {{max}} characters.
localeEntries./social/dm/sendFailed: The message was not sent. Try again!
localeEntries./social/dm/limit: You sent all {{max}} messages for today. Continue tomorrow.
localeEntries./social/dm/rule: Only the two of you see these. They are kept for 30 days, and the recipient can report them to a GM.
localeEntries./social/gift/claimedLost: Claimed: +{{energy}} energy. The rest was lost because your energy was full.
localeEntries./social/gift/claimedNone_one: You were full, so the gift's energy was lost.
localeEntries./social/gift/claimedNone_other: You were full, so the gifts' energy was lost.
localeEntries./social/party/goal_one: First week: everyone reaches level {{level}} ({{done}}/{{total}}), {{count}} day left
localeEntries./social/party/goal_other: First week: everyone reaches level {{level}} ({{done}}/{{total}}), {{count}} days left
localeEntries./social/party/goalDone: First week done: you all earned the title.
localeEntries./stable/greeting: Saddle up! On a mount you reach the stones much sooner, and my horse says you look better up there too.
localeEntries./stable/greetingRiding: So, how's the {{mount}} treating you? If you extend, the expiry moves later, it doesn't start over.
localeEntries./stable/now/none: You're on foot. Rent a mount and every foray gets shorter.
localeEntries./stable/stored/hint: Reward mounts wait here while you ride another one. Their days only count while you ride them; switching is free.
localeEntries./stable/stored/riding: You are riding {{name}} now. Your previous mount waits in the stable.
localeEntries./stable/mounts/pony/flavor: A hardy steppe breed. Small, but it keeps going all day.
localeEntries./stable/mounts/warhorse/flavor: The border riders' mount. It stays calm when the storm roars.
localeEntries./stable/mounts/charger/flavor: An armoured warhorse from the imperial stables. Quick, even with heavy steps.
localeEntries./stable/mounts/stormtiger/flavor: Striped by the Storm Dragon's sparks. It flashes between the stones like lightning.
localeEntries./stable/mounts/lidercparipa/flavor: The steed of the Night of the Dead Stones, woven from wisp-light. It glows faintly at night.
localeEntries./stable/mounts/kilencfarku_roka/flavor: A gift from Hwaryeon. One of its nine tails always points the shortest way.
localeEntries./stable/mounts/mule/flavor: The pack animal of the mountain passes. Stubborn, but sure-footed on the steepest trail.
localeEntries./stable/mounts/miststeed/flavor: Born of the mist on the mountain peaks. By the time you spot it, it is already in the next valley.
localeEntries./stable/replaceWarning: The time left on your current mount will be lost.
localeEntries./stable/errors/level_required: This mount needs a higher level.
localeEntries./stable/errors/unknown_mount: There's no such mount in the stable.
localeEntries./stage/rotate/hint: If the screen does not turn, switch off the rotation lock.
localeEntries./stage/rotate/hintSplit: In split view, drag the game window wider.
localeEntries./stage/hud/toolbar: Purse, energy, settings and full screen
localeEntries./stage/hud/energyReserve: Energy: {{energy}} / {{max}}, plus {{reserve}} above your daily max
localeEntries./stage/hud/fullscreenHint: The game fills the whole display. On a phone it also locks landscape.
localeEntries./stage/nav/hint/city: Blacksmith, shop, notice board and the townsfolk.
localeEntries./stage/nav/hint/character: Stats, gear, inventory, path, bonuses, achievements and companions.
localeEntries./stage/nav/hint/hunt: Forays, hunting spots, the map's boss and the dungeons.
localeEntries./stage/nav/hint/premium: Coin packs, the Imperial Pass, offers and the Storm Coin shop.
localeEntries./stage/nav/hint/arena: Bandit League and classic Arena: fights against other adventurers.
localeEntries./stage/nav/hint/tower: Floor after floor of tougher and tougher foes.
localeEntries./stage/nav/hint/guild: Shared buildings, raids and plenty of arguing.
localeEntries./stage/nav/hint/ranking: Find out who is the strongest on the server.
localeEntries./stage/nav/hint/leads: Short skill games: they come from active fights, and better play pays more.
localeEntries./stage/nav/hint/mine: Gwangsu's mines and the Smelter: ore, bars and pickaxes.
localeEntries./stage/hunt/gateText: Beat the previous map's boss and the road opens.
localeEntries./stage/tip/profile/points_one: You have {{count}} stat point to spend.
localeEntries./stage/tip/profile/points_other: You have {{count}} stat points to spend.
localeEntries./stage/tip/profile/open: Click it for the character sheet.
localeEntries./stage/tip/xp/max: You have reached the top level.
localeEntries./stage/tip/xp/source: Hunting, stone breaking and bosses bring it.
localeEntries./stage/tip/energy/full: Full, off you go to break some stones.
localeEntries./stage/tip/energy/cost: Forays cost energy: the longer, the more.
localeEntries./stage/tip/nyang/hint: Hunting and selling bring it, the blacksmith and the shop take it.
localeEntries./stage/tip/coins/hint: Premium money for the Imperial Pass, mounts and upgrades. Click to top up.
localeEntries./stage/tip/coins/hintNoPay: Premium money for the Imperial Pass, mounts and upgrades.
localeEntries./stage/tip/mods/none: No boosts on you right now.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stat/primary: Your main stat: +{{min}}-{{max}} damage per point.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stat/notPrimary: Not your main stat, it does not raise damage.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stat/notPrimaryDex: Not your main stat: it doesn't make your hits bigger, but they land and crit more often, and you dodge more.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stat/str: The key to a heavier blow.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stat/dex: +{{crit}} critical chance per point, up to {{critCap}}. Measured against your opponent's DEX it also decides how often your hits land, how often you dodge ({{evade}} per point of difference, up to {{evadeMax}}, less against bosses) and who strikes first.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stat/int: +{{sp}} SP per point. Your skill runs on SP.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stat/vsBossYou: Evasion and hit chance are measured against a boss of your level (DEX {{dex}}). You have more DEX, so you strike first.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stat/vsBossFoe: Evasion and hit chance are measured against a boss of your level (DEX {{dex}}). It has more DEX, so it strikes first.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stat/vsBossTie: Evasion and hit chance are measured against a boss of your level (DEX {{dex}}). Your DEX is the same, so chance decides who strikes first.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stat/add: Use the plus button to put a point in.
localeEntries./stage/tip/split/rule: Two of every three points go to your main stat ({{main}}), one to Vitality. You hit harder and last longer.
localeEntries./stage/tip/split/ruleHc: The points go where they add the most Combat Power. Combat Power is measured against a boss of your level, so this split is made for bosses. In the arena Dexterity can be worth more than it shows here; you can also place the points by hand.
localeEntries./stage/tip/split/notePanel: The button only fills in the points, Save makes them final.
localeEntries./stage/tip/split/noteLevelUp: You confirm before anything is spent.
localeEntries./stage/tip/derived/maxHp: How much damage you can take in a fight. Your level, Vitality and gear raise it.
localeEntries./stage/tip/derived/maxSp: SP is what your skills run on: every skill pays with it. Intelligence raises it.
localeEntries./stage/tip/derived/attack: The damage of a plain hit. Your weapon, main stat and level make it.
localeEntries./stage/tip/derived/def: Every hit you take is smaller by this much. Armour, Vitality and your level make it.
localeEntries./stage/tip/derived/critChance: Chance of a hit dealing one and a half times the damage. Dexterity and gear raise it, up to 50%.
localeEntries./stage/tip/derived/evadeBonus: How much more often you dodge a blow. It comes from gear.
localeEntries./stage/tip/derived/nyangBonus: How much more nyang monsters drop. It comes from gear.
localeEntries./stage/tip/derived/xpBonus: How much more experience you get. It comes from gear.
localeEntries./stage/tip/spot/open: Click and they will talk to you.
localeEntries./stage/tip/map/content: {{spots}} hunting spots, {{stones}} stormstones and the boss: {{boss}}.
localeEntries./stage/tip/stone/reward: The bigger the stone, the bigger the loot.
localeEntries./stage/tip/boss/everyWin: Every win gives loot; each fight uses one attempt.
localeEntries./stage/tip/chance/scroll: An Ashward Scroll does not raise the chance, but it saves the item if it fails.
localeEntries./stage/tip/chance/higher: The higher you go, the lower the chance.
localeEntries./stage/energyReserve/what: Energy from purchases and rewards (Fair Wheel, events) on top of your daily {{max}}. It is not lost: you spend it just like the rest.
localeEntries./stage/energyReserve/from: Reward energy above the max is not carried over to the next day: it lasts until the daily rollover, so use it the same day.
localeEntries./stage/energyReserve/bought: Bought energy not yet spent: {{bought}}. It is used last and carries over to the next day.
localeEntries./stage/energyReserve/reset: At the daily rollover ({{at}}) your free energy is refilled to {{day}}. Leftover free energy expires. Only bought energy carries over to the next day.
localeEntries./stage/energyRegen/paused: The daytime refill is paused while your energy is full.
localeEntries./stage/energyRegen/rule: At the daily rollover ({{at}}) you get your whole daily free energy ({{max}}) at once, use it whenever you like. Leftover free energy expires, bought energy is kept.
localeEntries./stage/fullscreenHelp/offerText: The browser bars disappear and the picture stays in landscape.
localeEntries./stage/fullscreenHelp/guideText: In Safari the browser bars take up part of the picture.
localeEntries./stage/fullscreenHelp/stepSafariHint: In the ••• menu: open in browser.
localeEntries./stage/fullscreenHelp/stepAddHint: Scroll down the list to find it.
localeEntries./stage/fullscreenHelp/stepOpen: Start the game from its icon
localeEntries./stage/fullscreenHelp/stepOpenHint: If it asks you to log in, use the same account.
localeEntries./stage/fullscreenHelp/guestNote: The game started from the Home Screen counts as a separate browser.
localeEntries./stage/fullscreenHelp/settingsHint: How to get rid of the browser bars.
localeEntries./stage/fullscreenHelp/quickText: Tap the button at the left of the address bar (Page Menu or aA), then ••• if needed, and choose “Hide Toolbar”. Tap the bottom of the screen to bring it back.
localeEntries./stage/fullscreenHelp/bestTitle: Best: add it to your Home Screen, it then runs with no bars
localeEntries./stage/sale/line: Sale: {{pct}} Storm Coins on every Storm Coin pack, until {{day}} {{time}}
localeEntries./stage/worldLevel/what: The world’s recommended level: it rises with the days since the world opened, every day at {{time}}.
localeEntries./stage/worldLevel/wind: Catch-up wind: from level {{min}}, heroes {{near}}+ levels below the world level get +{{nearPct}}% XP, {{far}}+ levels below get +{{farPct}}%.
localeEntries./stonerain/intro: Stones are falling on the town! Smash them. Strike when the golden ring reaches the edge of the stone: that counts double.
localeEntries./stonerain/warn/soon: Stone Rain over the town in two minutes! Bring a hammer. If you have none, your sword will do.
localeEntries./stonerain/hud/tip: Four times a day (five at weekends), stones rain on the town for five minutes. Smash as many as you can: the shared goal brings a blessing for everyone.
localeEntries./stonerain/stone/capped: Falling stone. You've reached the maximum, it no longer counts toward the shared goal.
localeEntries./stonerain/goal/reached: Shared goal reached! A blessing falls on the town for an hour.
localeEntries./stonerain/goal/tier2: One and a half times the goal! The blessing lasts 90 minutes and brings nyang too.
localeEntries./stonerain/goal/tip: The goal follows how many heroes are active in the world when the rain starts. Each hero can add at most {{cap}} broken stones per rain.
localeEntries./stonerain/goal/capped: You've reached the maximum: further hits no longer count toward the shared goal.
localeEntries./stonerain/result/waiting: The town is still counting the stones…
localeEntries./stonerain/result/cap: You have reached today's cap of 120 rewarded stones. Your stones still counted toward the shared goal.
localeEntries./stonerain/result/flagged: Half the reward for this rain: the server found your hits too machine-like.
localeEntries./stonerain/result/later: You can collect the result for 48 hours from the Stone Rain sign on the HUD.
localeEntries./stonerain/result/nothing: You didn't smash any stones in this rain. Next time!
localeEntries./stonerain/result/world/reached: Shared goal: {{pct}}. Done! A blessing falls on the town for an hour.
localeEntries./stonerain/result/world/tier2: Shared goal: {{pct}}. One and a half times over: 90 minutes of blessing, with nyang.
localeEntries./stonerain/result/world/missed: Shared goal: {{pct}}, not reached this time. The stones aren't offended. They'll be back.
localeEntries./stonerain/result/blessing/reached: Shared goal reached: +{{xp}} XP and +{{drop}} loot for {{minutes}} minutes.
localeEntries./stonerain/result/blessing/tier2: Shared goal reached one and a half times over: +{{xp}} XP, +{{drop}} loot and +{{nyang}} nyang for {{minutes}} minutes.
localeEntries./stonerain/result/blessing/missed: The shared goal wasn’t reached this time, so there’s no blessing.
localeEntries./stonerain/buff/tip: The town reached the Stone Rain’s shared goal, so every hero in the world gets the blessing.
localeEntries./stonerain/today/stone_rain/where: The town, when the stones fall.
localeEntries./stonerain/today/stone_rain/now: Stones are falling on the town right now!
localeEntries./stonerain/today/stone_rain/done: You were at today's Stone Rain.
localeEntries./stonerain/errors/rain_not_active: This Stone Rain has already stopped.
localeEntries./stonerain/errors/hits_late: The Stone Rain ended before your last hits arrived, so they did not count.
localeEntries./stonerain/errors/hits_not_joined: You have not joined this Stone Rain, so your hits do not count. Reload the page to join.
localeEntries./stonerain/errors/rain_not_settled: The town is still counting the stones. A few seconds and you can collect.
localeEntries./stonerain/errors/rain_expired: This reward has expired: it could be collected for 48 hours.
localeEntries./stonerain/errors/rain_claimed: You have already collected this reward.
localeEntries./stonerain/errors/rain_nothing: You have no reward to collect from this Stone Rain.
localeEntries./stonerain/errors/rain_react_cooldown: Slow down a little: you can shout again in {{retryAfter}} s.
localeEntries./stonerain/feed/rain_result: The Stone Rain has stopped: the shared goal was reached ({{pct}})!
localeEntries./stonerain/feed/rain_result_missed: The Stone Rain has stopped; the shared goal wasn’t reached this time.
localeEntries./stonerain/feed/rain_top: {{name}} smashed the most stones in the Stone Rain: {{stones}}. The stones have filed a complaint.
localeEntries./stonerain/town/cry: The village smashed the Stone Rain!
localeEntries./stones/sell/chiselFirst: To keep them, chisel them out at the blacksmith first (Sockets).
localeEntries./tower/intro: The old empire built the Stormcatcher to catch the storm before it hit the ground. It never caught the storm, but a demon moved in, and he has been subletting the floors to the worst crowd in the land ever since.
localeEntries./tower/floors/0: On the lower floors the toughest enemy is the stairs, and the monsters come second.
localeEntries./tower/floors/1: Fox hair on the banister, perfume in the corridor: someone is expecting you.
localeEntries./tower/floors/2: A sign on the wall says: please take a number. Yours has already been called.
localeEntries./tower/floors/3: Sulphur, heat and overdue rent, and up here even the monsters walk on tiptoe.
localeEntries./tower/bosses/tower_boss_1/line: Password? Wrong. I don't know the right one either, but it isn't that.
localeEntries./tower/bosses/tower_boss_2/line: Look into my eyes, just for a moment. There, you've already forgotten why you came.
localeEntries./tower/bosses/tower_boss_3/line: I checked the list. You're on it, just a little earlier than you expected.
localeEntries./tower/bosses/tower_boss_4/line: Who let you in? Oh, the tenants. Rent goes up tomorrow.
localeEntries./tower/cooldown/why: The tower allows one attempt every 20 minutes, {{time}} until the next one.
localeEntries./tower/cooldown/rule: One attempt every 20 minutes: after a win or a loss alike, you rest for 20 minutes.
localeEntries./tower/cooldown/resetLabel: Next floor now for {{cost}} Storm Coins
localeEntries./tower/done/text: You have climbed all 120 floors. The demon moved out, and now the tenants ask you when the hot water is coming back.
localeEntries./tower/result/lost: Floor {{floor}}: the tower won this time.
localeEntries./tower/errors/cooldown: The tower won't let you in yet, wait for the next attempt.
localeEntries./tower/errors/no_cooldown: No need to wait any more, the attempt can start.
localeEntries./tower/errors/inventory_full: Your inventory is full, and a first clear gives you an item. Sell something, then come back.
localeEntries./tower/paidCaps/resetCapped: No paid retries left today; they come back after midnight (Budapest time). Until then you can try for free after the wait.
localeEntries./tower/paidCaps/rule: At most {{max}} retries a day, each pricier than the last.
localeEntries./twitch/weeks/lead: A new campaign starts every Friday at 19:00 CET and runs until the next Friday at 18:59 CET, every week until 4 December. Any Stonestorm stream on Twitch counts.
localeEntries./twitch/steps/lead: Within a campaign your watch time adds up. You get a chest at each of these steps:
localeEntries./twitch/chests/levelup/contents: Elixir of Experience for 1 day, or the XP of 1-2 hours of AFK hunting
localeEntries./twitch/chests/levelup/short: Elixir of Experience or AFK hunting XP
localeEntries./twitch/chests/nyang/contents: Gold Fever Elixir for 1-2 days, or the nyang of 2-3 hours of AFK hunting
localeEntries./twitch/chests/nyang/short: Gold Fever Elixir or AFK hunting nyang
localeEntries./twitch/chests/hunter/contents: Hunter's Luck Elixir for 2-3 days, or 2-3 Boss Passes, or 2-3 Luck Ore
localeEntries./twitch/chests/hunter/short: Hunter's Luck Elixir, Boss Passes or Luck Ore
localeEntries./twitch/chests/timewarp/contents: 3-12 Twitch Hourglasses: each is 1 hour of time jump on top of the daily limit
localeEntries./twitch/chests/timewarp/short: 3-12 Twitch Hourglasses, 1 hour of time jump each
localeEntries./twitch/chests/energy/contents: 50-200 energy that is kept past the daily reset
localeEntries./twitch/chests/energy/short: 50-200 energy, kept past the daily reset
localeEntries./twitch/chests/stormwatcher/contents: Stormwatcher's Brew for 1 day: +15% XP, +15% nyang and +15% loot
localeEntries./twitch/chests/stormwatcher/short: +15% XP, nyang and loot for 1 day
localeEntries./twitch/chests/war/contents: Brute Force Brew or Thick Skin Brew for 1-3 days
localeEntries./twitch/facts/wait: Chests wait in the game for 7 days. Any of your heroes can open them and gets the reward.
localeEntries./twitch/facts/extra: Twitch brews work next to the brews you bought, on top of them.
localeEntries./twitch/facts/bound: Twitch rewards are bound to your account: they cannot be sold or traded.
localeEntries./twitch/facts/permanent: One game account can link one Twitch account, and the link is permanent.
localeEntries./twitch/how/claim: When Twitch tells you the reward is ready, claim it on Twitch, for example here:
localeEntries./twitch/link/signIn: To link, sign in to your Stonestorm account. After signing in we bring you back to this page.
localeEntries./twitch/link/soon: Linking opens soon. Check back later!
localeEntries./twitch/link/guest: A guest account cannot link Twitch. Save your account first.
localeEntries./twitch/link/lead: Link your Twitch account so your Twitch Drops chests arrive here.
localeEntries./twitch/link/confirmText: You cannot change or remove the Twitch account later, and this Twitch account cannot be linked to another game account. In the next step, check on Twitch which account you are signed in with.
localeEntries./twitch/link/permanent: The link is permanent. If you linked the wrong account, contact support.
localeEntries./twitch/linked: Done! Your Twitch account is linked.
localeEntries./twitch/errors/taken: This Twitch account already belongs to another game account.
localeEntries./twitch/errors/alreadyLinked: This game account already has a Twitch account.
localeEntries./twitch/errors/expired: The link expired or was interrupted. Please try again.
localeEntries./twitch/errors/cancelled: You cancelled the link on Twitch.
localeEntries./twitch/errors/unavailable: Twitch is not reachable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
localeEntries./twitch/errors/disabled: Linking is not available right now.
localeEntries./twitch/errors/guest: A guest account cannot link Twitch. Save your account first.
localeEntries./twitch/errors/signedOut: Sign in first, then try linking again.
localeEntries./twitch/errors/rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
localeEntries./twitch/account/lead: Link your Twitch account and get chests in the game for watching Stonestorm streams (Twitch Drops).
localeEntries./twitch/hero/pitch: Watch anyone streaming Stonestorm on Twitch, and chests arrive in the game.
localeEntries./twitch/flow/link/text: Sign in and link your Twitch account. You only do it once, and the link is permanent.
localeEntries./twitch/flow/watch/text: Any Stonestorm stream counts. Your watch time adds up within the weekly campaign.
localeEntries./twitch/flow/claim/text: The chest arrives in the game within a few minutes and waits for you for 7 days.
localeEntries./twitchchest/off: Twitch Drops are paused right now, you can open your chests later.
localeEntries./twitchchest/empty: No chest to open right now. Watch a Stonestorm stream on Twitch and the chest you earn arrives here.
localeEntries./twitchchest/note: Any hero of your account can open a chest, and its contents stay with that hero. Each chest shows how long it still waits.
localeEntries./twitchchest/hud/hint: Twitch Drops reward. It works on its own beside a bought brew and counts above the multiplier cap too.
localeEntries./twitchchest/hud/openHint: Tap to open the chests that arrived.
localeEntries./twitchchest/warp/twitch: Twitch hourglasses: {{n}}. They are used first and do not count toward the daily limit.
localeEntries./twitchchest/elixir/stormwatcher/desc: +15% XP, nyang and loot. Only from Twitch Drops chests.
localeEntries./twitchchest/chest/levelup/desc: Elixir of Experience for a day, or the XP of 1-2 hours of idle hunting.
localeEntries./twitchchest/chest/nyang/desc: Gold Fever Elixir for 1-2 days, or the nyang of 2-3 hours of idle hunting.
localeEntries./twitchchest/chest/hunter/desc: Hunter's Luck Elixir for 2-3 days, Boss Pass ×2-3 or Luck Ore ×2-3.
localeEntries./twitchchest/chest/timewarp/desc: Time-Jump Hourglass ×3-12, on top of the daily limit.
localeEntries./twitchchest/chest/stormwatcher/desc: Stormwatcher's Brew for 1 day: +15% XP, nyang and loot.
localeEntries./twitchchest/chest/energy/desc: 50-200 energy that stays past the day change.
localeEntries./twitchchest/chest/war/desc: Brute Force Brew or Thick Skin Brew for 1-3 days.
localeEntries./twitchchest/outcome/afkXp: {{xp}} XP, the yield of {{hours}} of idle hunting
localeEntries./twitchchest/outcome/afkNyang: {{nyang}} nyang, the yield of {{hours}} of idle hunting
localeEntries./twitchchest/outcome/levelUp: Level up! You are level {{level}} now.
localeEntries./twitchchest/outcome/energyCut: {{lost}} energy did not fit because you reached the cap.
localeEntries./war/balance/switch/lead: Your hero can move to another kingdom once, for free, until {{until}}. Once the gates open, kingdoms are final.
localeEntries./war/balance/switch/confirm: Move to {{kingdom}}? You can only do this once.
localeEntries./war/balance/switch/errors/generic: The switch didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
localeEntries./war/balance/switch/errors/kingdom_locke: The gates are open: kingdoms are final now.
localeEntries./war/balance/switch/errors/kingdom_switc: You've already used your free switch.
You can't switch kingdoms while in a guild. Leave your guild first.
Kingdom switching isn't available right now.
localeEntries./war/balance/switch/errors/insufficient_: You don't have enough Storm Coins for the kingdom change.
localeEntries./war/balance/switch/errors/kingdom_chang: The wait between two changes isn't over yet.
Before launch, the free switch is available.
localeEntries./war/balance/change/lead: Your hero can move to another kingdom for {{coins}} Storm Coins. You must wait {{days}} days between two changes.
localeEntries./war/balance/change/cooldown: Your next kingdom change is possible from {{until}}.
localeEntries./war/balance/change/confirm: Move to {{kingdom}}? It costs {{coins}} Storm Coins, and you'll have to wait {{days}} days before the next change.
localeEntries./wheel/cityTexts/npc/wheel/greeting: Step right up, traveller! One spin a day is on the house, and luck never asks who you are.
localeEntries./wheel/cityTexts/npc/wheel/line: Nyang, potions, scrolls, Luck Ore, and if the Storm Dragon is feeling generous, a jackpot of fifty Storm Coins. The odds are posted right by the wheel. No tricks here, only thrills.
localeEntries./wheel/cityTexts/npc/wheel/locked: The wheel is resting now. It spins again tomorrow.
localeEntries./wheel/line/free: Your free spin for today is waiting. What are you waiting for?
localeEntries./wheel/line/done: No spins left for today. Same place after the daily rollover ({{at}}), same luck!
localeEntries./wheel/result/energyCapped: Your energy is at the cap, this is all that fit.
localeEntries./wheel/result/xpMax: No more XP at the level cap.
localeEntries./wheel/result/summary: The wheel stopped on {{slice}}. You won: {{prize}}.
localeEntries./wheel/hud/free: Your free spin for today is waiting!
localeEntries./wheel/hud/used: Today's free spin is used. The wheel turns again at the daily reset.
localeEntries./wheel/errors/no_free_spin: Today's free spin is already used. The wheel turns again at the daily reset.
localeEntries./wheel/oddsIndependent: Every spin is independent of the others. You get one free spin a day; spins cannot be bought with Storm Coins.
localeEntries./worlds/picker/lead: Each world is its own adventure, with its own market and rankings. You can start a hero in another world later, too.
localeEntries./worlds/picker/hasHero: You already have a hero here
localeEntries./worlds/select/lead: Which world are you adventuring in today?
localeEntries./worlds/errors/world_full: This world is full, no new heroes for now. Pick another one!
localeEntries./worlds/errors/world_not_open: This world hasn't opened yet. Patience, it's still being forged!
localeEntries./worlds/errors/hero_current: You are playing this hero right now. Switch heroes first, then you can delete it.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/hero_last: You can't delete your last hero. To delete everything, delete your account on the Account page.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/checkout_pending: This hero has a payment in progress. Wait until it finishes, then try again.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/account_coin_debt: One of your heroes owes Storm Coins after a charged-back payment. Until that's settled, you can't delete or create heroes or start a new purchase.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/confirm_mismatch: The name you typed doesn't match the hero's name.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/hero_restore_expired: The 7-day restore window has ended, this hero can't be brought back.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/hero_limit: You have reached four heroes in this world.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/hero_cooldown: You can start one new hero a day. Try again later.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/hero_kingdom_locked: Your account's heroes live in one kingdom, the new hero goes there too.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/hero_switched: You switched heroes in another tab, so the game reloads.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/friend_own_hero: Your own heroes can't be friends with each other.
localeEntries./worlds/errors/guild_own_hero: Two of your heroes are already in this guild. An account can have at most 2 heroes per guild.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/restoreDays_one: can be restored for {{count}} more day
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/restoreDays_other: can be restored for {{count}} more days
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/new/text: Starts completely separate, with its own Storm Coins and items.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/lock/unverified: Confirm your email address to unlock more heroes
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/lock/guest: Register and confirm your email address to unlock more heroes
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/lock/later: You can start a new hero a little later.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/create/kingdomFixed: All heroes on your account live in the same kingdom, the one you chose once. If you change kingdoms later, all your heroes move with you.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/create/aloneTitle: A new start, a separate life
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/create/aloneText: The new hero lives completely apart: its own Storm Coins, Imperial Pass, items and guild. Nothing carries over. It is like starting a new account, only you don't have to register again.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/create/ack: I understand: {{name}} starts at level 1 with empty hands.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/switch/keep: {{name}} keeps everything, and you can switch back any time.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/switch/own: This hero has its own Storm Coins, pass, items, guild and friends. The game reloads and you continue with this hero.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/menu/settingsHint: Your heroes, a new hero, deleting
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/deleteModal/lead: Deleting {{name}} loses everything that belongs to this hero:
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/deleteModal/coinsAll: All of the hero's Storm Coins
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/deleteModal/coinsNote: bought Storm Coins too, none of it moves to your other heroes
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/deleteModal/passDays_one: would still be valid for {{count}} day
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/deleteModal/passDays_othe: would still be valid for {{count}} days
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/deleteModal/itemsNote: the storage and the cosmetics too
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/deleteModal/restore_one: You can restore it in the hero picker for {{count}} day. After that it is deleted for good.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/deleteModal/restore_other: You can restore it in the hero picker for {{count}} days. After that it is deleted for good.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/deleteModal/typeName: Type the hero's name to confirm: {{name}}
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/offer/lead: Start a new hero on your account.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/offer/keep: It's free, and {{name}} stays exactly as it is.
localeEntries./worlds/heroes/offer/why: The free restart was available up to level {{level}} or in the first {{days}} days, and it has closed for this hero. The new hero lives apart: its own Storm Coins, pass, items and guild.

localeEntries./coach/boss/heavy: A heavy strike is coming: Block!
localeEntries./coach/boss/heavy_tiger: The tiger is winding up a strike: Block!
localeEntries./coach/boss/sweep_tiger: The tiger is about to sweep: Dodge!
localeEntries./coach/boss/channel_tiger: The tiger is gathering power: Interrupt, quick!
localeEntries./coach/boss/weak: A weak point! Tap the boss fast, again and again!
localeEntries./coach/boss/weak_tiger: The tiger shows a weak point! Tap it fast, again and again!
localeEntries./default/tours/portal_piece/1: You found a portal piece, dearie! Collect 9 and this map's portal opens. Forays, bosses and gold results on leads all turn up pieces.
localeEntries./default/tours/portal_full/1: The portal is ready! Step in and see what waits on the other side. It picks one of three games, and nobody knows which in advance.
localeEntries./default/tours/unlock_portal/1: Every map has its own portal, dearie: this board. It has 9 pieces, and once you have them all, it opens. Your first piece comes from the errands on a foray.
localeEntries./default/tours/leads/1: This is the Leads page: up to three leads wait for you here. Each one is a short game, and they never expire.
localeEntries./default/tours/leads/2: Play starts it. Bronze, silver or gold: better play brings more reward, and gold sometimes a portal piece too.
localeEntries./default/tours/leads/3: When the bank is full, a new lead offers a swap or turns into a tracker point. New leads come from active fights: forays, stones, bosses.
localeEntries./default/tours/play_lock/1: Watch the needle, dearie: when it's inside the glowing band, tap! It gets faster after every pin, and the band gets narrower.
localeEntries./default/tours/play_lock/2: The more pins you pick and the more time you have left, the better the result: bronze, silver or gold. The locked chest holds materials, and rarely an item.
localeEntries./default/tours/play_cracks/1: Tap a glowing point before it fades: every hit cracks the stone further. Leave the dark, hardened points alone!
localeEntries./default/tours/play_cracks/2: A dark point heals the crack back a step. When every line is cracked through, the stone splits. The reward is XP and nyang, and Stormstone Shards and materials can drop too.
localeEntries./default/tours/play_fishing/1: Hold down and the glowing bar rises; let go and it sinks. Keep it on the fish until the catch meter fills!
localeEntries./default/tours/play_fishing/2: While you're on the fish the meter fills, and when you slip off it drains. A catch gives nyang and fishing loot, rarely a Silver Scale treasure.
localeEntries./default/tours/play_tracks/1: Watch closely in which order the footprints flash, then tap them the same way. At the end, dig fast on the X!
localeEntries./default/tours/play_tracks/2: Three rounds come, each with a longer row. The right order and fast digging give a better result: the buried chest may hold an item too.
localeEntries./default/tours/play_aranyeso/1: Drag the basket under the falling treasure, dearie. Dodge the kobold: if it lands in your basket, it steals time!
localeEntries./default/tours/play_aranyeso/2: Now and then a shower of small coins comes, and rarely a fast-falling treasure. Golden Rain gives mostly materials and nyang.
localeEntries./default/tours/play_tanaka/1: You steer the catcher with the keys, the mouse or the joystick. Tanakas are faster than you, so corner them!
localeEntries./default/tours/play_tanaka/2: Every Tanaka you catch drops something, and you're faster for a moment afterwards. The net catches a wider circle, and the golden Tanaka is a rare, big catch.
localeEntries./default/tours/play_viharzapor/1: Stones are crashing onto the map, dearie, just like the Stone Rain on the town! Tap them. Strike when the golden ring reaches the edge of the stone: that counts double.
localeEntries./default/tours/play_viharzapor/2: A run of perfect strikes is a combo, and every fifth one brings bonus loot. After seven seconds a stone sinks into the ground, so don't leave it! Smash them all to end the storm.
localeEntries./default/tours/boss_react/1: Now and then the boss signals its skill: a sign and a filling bar above its head. Against a heavy strike, press Block and it barely hurts; otherwise it hits twice as hard.
localeEntries./default/tours/boss_react/2: Against a sweep, press Dodge and it misses you completely.
localeEntries./default/tours/boss_react/3: If it gathers power to heal or to rage, Interrupt it quickly, or it heals or hits harder.
localeEntries./default/tours/boss_react/4: When its weak point shows, tap the boss fast, several times in a row: your next hit does more damage.
localeEntries./default/tours/bonuszolo/1: You got a Bonus Reroller ({{band}}), dearie! It swaps a single bonus line of an item, without nyang, but only on level {{from}}-{{to}} items. Let's see Gangdo!
localeEntries./default/tours/bonuszolo/2: On the Bonuses tab you pick the item. A Bonus Reroller only works on items in its own level band.
localeEntries./default/tours/bonuszolo/3: With this button you pick the line to swap. It costs no nyang, the Bonus Reroller is used up, and if you don't like the new line, you can keep the old one.
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_harcero/1: Your Combat Power went up, dear: {{from}} → {{to}}. It is your hero's strength in one number, damage and toughness together. Better gear and the forge raise it; whether you beat a boss, its card's odds will tell you.
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_trophy/1: You earned a Feat! It is the bosses' shared trophy: bosses, dungeon end bosses and the tower's Echo give it. Gangdo uses Feats to awaken your gear, so keep collecting.
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_warp/1_one: This is the Time warp, dear. For Storm Coins you get a few hours of your hunting bag's yield right away. Your daily limit is {{count}} hour; hourglasses use it too.
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_warp/1_other: This is the Time warp, dear. For Storm Coins you get a few hours of your hunting bag's yield right away. Your daily limit is {{count}} hours; hourglasses use it too.
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_reserve/1_one: Your inventory is full, so {{count}} item went to the Reserve. It waits there, nothing was sold. Make room, then take it.
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_reserve/1_other: Your inventory is full, so {{count}} items went to the Reserve. They wait there, nothing was sold. Make room, then take them.
localeEntries./default/tours/unlock_worldboss/1: Level thirty: the weekly boss is open! The whole world fights it together, and you can hit it several times a day. You'll find it on the Dungeons page.
localeEntries./default/tours/unlock_heroic/1: Level fifty-five: heroic dungeons are open! The same ten rooms, tougher foes, better loot.
localeEntries./default/tours/unlock_heroic/2: One more thing, dear: Yakdo the alchemist has opened the Stormheart. You set stones in its six sockets and make them stronger by refining. Let me show you!
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_dg_paths/1: Doors, dear! After a won room you pick a bonus: a treasure, a trap, a shrine or your companion's room. Every room's fight is still yours to fight.
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_dg_curse/1: Every week each dungeon carries a curse. It makes things harder, but the run chest is richer.
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_dg_treasure/1: A treasure room! Play the little game: the better you do, the more the chest gives.
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_dg_guest/1: A rare guest! It does not show up every run. A golden monster or a hidden room: worth it.
localeEntries./default/tours/beat_dg_deeper/1: Open the chest now, or go deeper for double. Fall down there and the chest is gone. Your call, dear.
localeEntries./default/coach/boss/heavy: A heavy strike is coming: Block!
localeEntries./default/coach/boss/heavy_tiger: The tiger is winding up a strike: Block!
localeEntries./default/coach/boss/sweep_tiger: The tiger is about to sweep: Dodge!
localeEntries./default/coach/boss/channel_tiger: The tiger is gathering power: Interrupt, quick!
localeEntries./default/coach/boss/weak: A weak point! Tap the boss fast, again and again!
localeEntries./default/coach/boss/weak_tiger: The tiger shows a weak point! Tap it fast, again and again!
localeEntries./default/help/screens/leads: Leads: up to three leads wait here, each one a short game of skill.
localeEntries./default/help/screens/portal: Portal: every map has its own portal, made of 9 pieces.
localeEntries./default/help/screens/boss_react: Boss fights: watch the signals and press the right button.
localeEntries./default/help/screens/bonuszolo: Bonus Reroller: swaps one bonus line of an item, without nyang.
localeEntries./default/help/screens/play_lock: Lockpicking: tap when the needle is in the glowing band.
localeEntries./default/help/screens/play_cracks: Stone Splitting: hit the glowing weak points, leave the dark ones, and the stone splits.
localeEntries./default/help/screens/play_fishing: Fishing: keep the glowing bar on the fish.
localeEntries./default/help/screens/play_tracks: Tracking: tap the footprints in the same order.
localeEntries./default/help/screens/play_aranyeso: Golden Rain Field: catch the falling treasure with the basket.
localeEntries./default/help/screens/play_viharzapor: Stormfall: smash the stones crashing onto the map, just like the Stone Rain.
localeEntries./default/glossary/intro: The village's words, one sentence each. Words marked New are the ones you just met.
localeEntries./default/glossary/back: Back to the Book of tips
localeEntries./default/glossary/pick: Pick a word and I'll tell you what it means here.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/harcero/text: Your hero's strength in one number: damage and toughness together. Better gear and the forge raise it.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/merce/text: The Combat Power of an average hero of your class on this map. Above it the map is easier for you; whether you beat a boss, its odds tell you.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/energia/text: Forays use it. It refills at the daily reset and during the day; anything above the daily amount is carried-over energy.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/portya/text: Ten stations on the map, a choice at each. At the end the stone's guardians and a chest wait.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/zsak/text: Your background hunt's loot collects here, even while you are away. When it is full, collect it on the Hunt page.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/tartalek/text: When your inventory is full, loot goes here. Nothing is sold on its own: take it when you have room.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/viharko/text: A stone fallen from the sky. You smash it on forays, and its guardians drop loot.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/fokozat/text: An item's + level at the forge, like +5. The higher it is, the stronger the item and the riskier the next step.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/erosseg/text: A bonus line's level, like strength 3/5. You can reroll it on the forge's Bonuses tab.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/ve/text: The game's premium currency. You also earn it as a reward, and it speeds things up.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/idougras/text: For Storm Coins you get a few hours of your hunting bag's yield at once. There is a daily limit; hourglasses use it too.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/orjarat/text: When your energy runs out, Patrol brings a fight every few minutes. The first few pay in full.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/nyomok/text: After fights and forays you may find a lead. A lead is a short game that pays XP and nyang; your bank is small, so play them soon.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/nyomolvaso/text: When your bank is full you can turn a lead into a point. Enough points earn a title: Tracker.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/portal/text: You collect pieces on the map. Nine pieces open the portal, with a short game and bonus loot on the other side.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/szellemko/text: Comes from bosses. It goes into an item's socket and adds a bonus. Its name is its type and its grade as a Roman numeral, like Bandit II.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/foglalat/text: A slot on an item for a Spirit Stone. Higher-upgrade items get an extra one.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/vernyom/text: When a boss is wounded but does not fall, it leaves a Blood trail. Follow it from the boss card without using a try.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/viharut/text: The season's road: fights, stones and tasks earn Storm Points, and every tier pays a reward.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/unnepi_erme/text: The holidays' currency: you collect it by playing and spend it in the holiday shop. On the Night of the Dead Stones they are called Wisp Lanterns.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/kazamata/text: Ten rooms and an end boss. You get a dungeon key every day; a clear gives better gear.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/hasadek/text: The Storm Rift's reward; you can hold up to 200. Spend them on the Rift shelf: energy, a boss attempt, a dungeon key and looks.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/hostett/text: The bosses' shared reward from level 30: bosses, dungeon end bosses and the tower's Echo give them. Gangdo uses them to awaken your gear.
localeEntries./default/glossary/terms/heti_boss/text: The whole world fights it together; you can hit it several times a day. Rewards follow your damage.

localeEntries./tours/play_aranyeso/2: Now and then a shower of small coins comes, and rarely a fast-falling treasure. Golden Rain gives mostly materials and nyang.
localeEntries./tours/play_tanaka/1: You steer the catcher with the keys, the mouse or the joystick. Tanakas are faster than you, so corner them!
localeEntries./tours/play_tanaka/2: Every Tanaka you catch drops something, and you're faster for a moment afterwards. The net catches a wider circle, and the golden Tanaka is a rare, big catch.
localeEntries./tours/play_viharzapor/1: Stones are crashing onto the map, dearie, just like the Stone Rain on the town! Tap them. Strike when the golden ring reaches the edge of the stone: that counts double.
localeEntries./tours/play_viharzapor/2: A run of perfect strikes is a combo, and every fifth one brings bonus loot. After seven seconds a stone sinks into the ground, so don't leave it! Smash them all to end the storm.
localeEntries./tours/boss_react/1: Now and then the boss signals its skill: a sign and a filling bar above its head. Against a heavy strike, press Block and it barely hurts; otherwise it hits twice as hard.
localeEntries./tours/boss_react/2: Against a sweep, press Dodge and it misses you completely.
localeEntries./tours/boss_react/3: If it gathers power to heal or to rage, Interrupt it quickly, or it heals or hits harder.
localeEntries./tours/boss_react/4: When its weak point shows, tap the boss fast, several times in a row: your next hit does more damage.
localeEntries./tours/bonuszolo/1: You got a Bonus Reroller ({{band}}), dearie! It swaps a single bonus line of an item, without nyang, but only on level {{from}}-{{to}} items. Let's see Gangdo!
localeEntries./tours/bonuszolo/2: On the Bonuses tab you pick the item. A Bonus Reroller only works on items in its own level band.
localeEntries./tours/bonuszolo/3: With this button you pick the line to swap. It costs no nyang, the Bonus Reroller is used up, and if you don't like the new line, you can keep the old one.
localeEntries./tours/beat_harcero/1: Your Combat Power went up, dear: {{from}} → {{to}}. It is your hero's strength in one number, damage and toughness together. Better gear and the forge raise it; whether you beat a boss, its card's odds will tell you.
localeEntries./tours/beat_trophy/1: You earned a Feat! It is the bosses' shared trophy: bosses, dungeon end bosses and the tower's Echo give it. Gangdo uses Feats to awaken your gear, so keep collecting.
localeEntries./tours/beat_warp/1_one: This is the Time warp, dear. For Storm Coins you get a few hours of your hunting bag's yield right away. Your daily limit is {{count}} hour; hourglasses use it too.
localeEntries./tours/beat_warp/1_other: This is the Time warp, dear. For Storm Coins you get a few hours of your hunting bag's yield right away. Your daily limit is {{count}} hours; hourglasses use it too.
localeEntries./tours/beat_reserve/1_one: Your inventory is full, so {{count}} item went to the Reserve. It waits there, nothing was sold. Make room, then take it.
localeEntries./tours/beat_reserve/1_other: Your inventory is full, so {{count}} items went to the Reserve. They wait there, nothing was sold. Make room, then take them.
localeEntries./tours/unlock_worldboss/1: Level thirty: the weekly boss is open! The whole world fights it together, and you can hit it several times a day. You'll find it on the Dungeons page.
localeEntries./tours/unlock_heroic/1: Level fifty-five: heroic dungeons are open! The same ten rooms, tougher foes, better loot.
localeEntries./tours/unlock_heroic/2: One more thing, dear: Yakdo the alchemist has opened the Stormheart. You set stones in its six sockets and make them stronger by refining. Let me show you!
localeEntries./tours/beat_dg_paths/1: Doors, dear! After a won room you pick a bonus: a treasure, a trap, a shrine or your companion's room. Every room's fight is still yours to fight.
localeEntries./tours/beat_dg_curse/1: Every week each dungeon carries a curse. It makes things harder, but the run chest is richer.
localeEntries./tours/beat_dg_treasure/1: A treasure room! Play the little game: the better you do, the more the chest gives.
localeEntries./tours/beat_dg_guest/1: A rare guest! It does not show up every run. A golden monster or a hidden room: worth it.
localeEntries./tours/beat_dg_deeper/1: Open the chest now, or go deeper for double. Fall down there and the chest is gone. Your call, dear.
